title: Drafter
description:
We are a Vancouver based supplier and installer of high – end European window, door, sliding door and

facade systems for luxury residential projects in Western Canada.

Our team is hiring an experienced Glazing Drafter to support the business. You will be

responsible to prepare and revise shop drawings for high- end residential window and door

projects.

You will work with the architectural drawings, structural drawings, site measurements, product

system details markups, and internal standards to create accurate shop drawing packages.



This role is ideal for someone with hands on experience in:

? Window and Door shop drawings

? Curtain wall / façade drafting

? Aluminum glazing systems

? Architectural drafting

? Revit and or AutoCAD experience

? Construction documentation

? Reading and understanding architectural and structural drawings



Skills required:

? Strong AutoCAD skills required

? REVIT experience preferred

? Ability to read architectural drawings and understand plans, elevations, sections, details, schedules, grids,

dimensions and levels.

? Understanding of residential construction and building envelope coordination

? Ability to draft clean, organized, dimensional shop drawings

? Strong attention to detail

? Good written English

? Reliable internet connection and computer set-up

? Able to work independently without constant supervision



Key Responsibilities

? Prepare shop drawings for windows, doors, sliding doors, curtain wall-style glazing and

related aluminum systems.

? Draft elevations, plans, sections, enlarged details, schedules, and installation details

? Interpret architectural drawings, structural drawings, specifications, schedules, and

consultant markups

? Coordinate rough openings, finished floor levels, sill conditions, head/jamb details,

anchoring intent, waterproofing interfaces and clearances

? Prepare window and door schedules with sizes, configurations, opening types, glass

notes, finishes and comments

? Revise drawings based on internal review comments, architect comments, engineer

comments and site conditions

? Check your own work for accuracy before submitting

? Maintain organized drawing files, revisions and issue dates

? Communicate clearly with the project manager and internal team

? Help improve company drafting templates and shop drawing standards over time.



We are looking for a real technical drafter – not just someone who can trace architectural plans. You

must understand how drawings are used for coordination, fabrication, approval and installation.



Application Instructions:

To apply, please send:

1. Your updated resume

2. Your portfolio or sample shop drawings

3. A short video introduction, maximum of 2 minutes answering:

? What type of glazing /window/façade drafting have you done?

? What software do you use best: AutoCAD or Revit etc.?

? What is the most technically difficult drawing package you have worked on?

4. Your expected monthly salary or hourly rate

5. Your available working hours

6. Your internet speed and computer specifications

7. In the subject line, write: Glazing Drafter – I understand shop drawings





Note: Applications without sample drawings or the correct subject line may not be reviewed

title: Executive Assistant to Founder
description:
Executive Assistant to Founder — Fast-Moving UK Marketing Agency (GoHighLevel a Big Plus)



Full-time · Remote · Long-term · UK business hours overlap required





About the role



I run a B2B performance marketing agency in the UK. We help service businesses (auto repair, legal, and a few other niches) get more customers, and we're growing fast across multiple offers at once. I move quickly, I care about output, and I have too many things on my plate.



I'm looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant who can take work off me — not create more of it. If you're the kind of person who reads a messy brain-dump, turns it into a clear list of actions, and just gets them done without needing to be chased, we'll get along very well.



This is a genuine right-hand role. Over time you'll know how the business runs better than almost anyone, and you'll be trusted with more.





What you'll actually do day to day





Inbox & calendar management — keep my
 under control, flag what matters, draft replies in my voice, book and protect my time.

Task & project tracking — chase the team (delivery, tech, sales) on open tasks, keep our project boards up to date, make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

Client onboarding admin — set up and organise accounts inside our CRM (GoHighLevel), prep onboarding docs, keep client records tidy.

Reporting & data pulls — grab numbers from GHL, Stripe, and ad platforms, drop them into simple summaries so I can make decisions fast.

SOPs & documentation — turn the way we do things into clean, repeatable process docs.

Research & prep — pull together info I need before calls, meetings, and decisions.

General delegation catch-all — the random "can you sort this out for me" tasks that come up every day.





You won't need to do all of this on day one. But you should be excited to grow into it.





Who you are





2+ years as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Operations/Admin role — ideally supporting a founder or business owner.

Excellent written English. You can write a clear, professional
 that sounds like a human, not a robot.

Proactive and organised. You spot problems before they blow up and you follow through without being reminded.

Comfortable with numbers and tools. Spreadsheets don't scare you. You learn new software quickly.

Reliable and available during UK hours (at least a solid overlap with 9am–5pm GMT).

Discreet and trustworthy — you'll have access to sensitive parts of the business.

Direct communicator. I value honesty and initiative over waiting to be told what to do.





Big bonus points if you have





GoHighLevel (GHL) experience — sub-accounts, workflows, snapshots, contacts. This is a major advantage and could mean a higher starting rate.

Experience inside a marketing agency environment.

Familiarity with tools like Stripe, Slack, Google Workspace, Apollo, Clay, or ad platforms (Meta / Google Ads).

Basic understanding of sales pipelines and CRM hygiene.



I read every application properly, so please do the same with this post.



1. Start your application with the word "COCKPIT" so I know you read to the end.



2. Send me a 3-minute Loom video (
 — it's free) introducing yourself and talking through your work experience. Keep it to 3 minutes. I want to hear how you communicate, so please speak in English. Tell me:

   - Who you are and what you've done

   - A time you took something completely off a boss's plate and ran with it

   - Your experience with GoHighLevel (be honest — "none" is fine, it's a bonus not a requirement)



3. In your written application, tell me your available hours in GMT/UK time.



Applications with no Loom video, or that skip the steps above, won't be read. Follow them and you've already shown me the quality I'm hiring for.

title: QA Automation Consultant
description:
QA Automation Consultant / Test Automation Architect



Location: Cebu or Manila, Philippines (Remote-first, aligned to Australian business hours – AEST)



Employment Type: Fixed-term engagement | Potential casual/project work after initial uplift



The Role



C9 is looking for a senior, hands-on QA Automation Consultant / Test Automation Architect to help us establish a standardised, repeatable and practical test automation capability across our software delivery teams.



This is primarily an internal capability-building role, not a role dedicated to one client project. The initial focus will be to help C9 define and implement the right testing frameworks, tooling standards, processes, templates and training so our developers and QA tea
mbers can apply consistent automated testing practices across future projects.



You will work with our team to assess our current approach, recommend fit-for-purpose tooling, build reusable framework patterns, document clear standards, and train others to apply them. The role will cover layered automation across unit testing, mock/service testing, API testing, component testing, UI/E2E testing, and load/performance testing.



There may be occasional involvement in client projects where your expertise is required, but the core purpose of this fixed-term role is to uplift C9's internal delivery capability. After the initial fixed-term engagement, there may be an opportunity to continue with C9 on a casual, contract or project-by-project basis as testing needs arise.







Responsibilities



Assess C9's current QA automation approach and identify practical improvement opportunities.

Define standard testing tools, frameworks and patterns for use across C9 projects.

Create a layered test automation framework covering:

Unit tests

Mock / service tests

API and integration tests

Component tests

UI / end-to-end tests

Load and performance tests

Smoke/regression validation in CI/CD pipelines

Establish recommended tooling and framework choices across our main technology stacks.

Create reusable templates, examples, documentation and implementation guidance.

Help define practical processes for when and how each testing layer should be used.

Support standardisation 
 / Microsoft projects, including C#, .NET, ASP.NET, SQL Server, Azure DevOps and Azure-hosted applications.

Support appropriate approaches for PHP and open-source projects, including Laravel or similar environments.

Integrate testing patterns into Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD workflows.

Train and mentor developers, QA tea
mbers and delivery leads so the approach can be adopted consistently.

Help C9 avoid fragile, one-off automation scripts by creating maintainable frameworks that delivery teams can understand and extend.

Provide occasional project-based support for client engagements where deeper QA automation expertise is required.





What we're looking for



Extensive hands-on experience designing and implementing test automation frameworks, not just executing test cases.

Proven experience implementing layered test automation across multiple environments, ideally across 4+ separate companies, products, projects or client contexts.

Strong background in 
 / Microsoft testing ecosystem, including tools such as:

xUnit, NUnit or MSTest

Moq, NSubstitute or similar mocking frameworks

Playwright, Selenium or comparable UI automation tools

Azure DevOps pipelines and test reporting

Experience designing and implementing test automation across:

Unit testing

API/integration testing

Mocking and service virtualisation

Component testing

UI/E2E testing

Load and performance testing

Experience testing APIs and services using tools/frameworks such as:

Postman / Newman

REST clients

Pact



Testcontainers

Swagger/OpenAPI validation

Experience implementing load and performance testing using tools such as:

Azure Load Testing

JMeter

k6

Locust

Playwright-based performance checks where appropriate

Comfortable working across PHP and open-source projects, including frameworks such as PHPUnit, Pest, Codeception or similar.

Actual experience designing and implementing automated tests that fit into CI/CD, release gates, regression packs, deployment validation and delivery quality.

Ability to design standards and frameworks that are pragmatic, maintainable and realistic for small-to-mid-sized delivery teams.

Strong documentation and training capability — this role requires you to enable others, not just build solutions yourself.

Ability to communicate testing strategy clearly to developers, QA tea
mbers, project coordinators and management.





Bonus (Nice to Have)



Experience creating test automation standards across a software consultancy, digital agency, systems integrator or multi-project delivery environment.

Experience training or mentoring development/QA teams in automation practices.

Experience with Azure PaaS, Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Functions, Service Bus or API Management.

Experience with React, Angular or Vue component testing.

Experience with accessibility testing, security testing, dependency scanning or static analysis.

Experience with Azure Test Plans, Jira, Zephyr, AIO Tests, TestRail or similar test management tools.

ISTQB or equivalent certification is useful, but practical framework implementation experience matters more.





Why join C9



This is an opportunity to shape how C9 approaches automated testing across our delivery portfolio. You will not simply be joining to write tests for one project — you will help define the standards, tools, frameworks and training that our teams can reuse across many future projects.



You'll work with a practical, delivery-focused software team across Microsoft, PHP/open-source and mixed-technology environments. If you enjoy building frameworks, improving engineering maturity, mentoring others and creating repeatable quality practices, this role should be a strong fit.



C9 supports remote-first delivery, so the role is well suited to someone who is highly autonomous, organised and effective working from home.







Working Arrangements



Remote; must be available during Australian Business Hours (AEST). Tools and equipment provided per company policy.



This is intended as a fixed-term capability uplift engagement focused on C9's internal QA automation standards, tooling, process and training.



The initial engagement will focus on building the foundations: recommended tooling, framework templates, process guidance, training material and adoption support.



After the initial engagement, there may be an opportunity to continue with C9 on a casual, contract or project-by-project basis, particularly where client projects require specialist QA automation support.



This role is remote / work from home, with limited need for travel.







Remuneration & Incentives



Remuneration and incentives commensurate with experience.





How to Apply



Send your CV and a short note outlining:



a layered automation framework you have implemented;

the testing layers it covered;

the technology stack used;

how you trained or enabled others to use it; and

how it improved delivery confidence, regression coverage or release quality.

Note:



Our interview process includes a mandatory live video checkpoint to verify your physical location. Candidates must be permanently based and interviewing in the Philippines to ensure compliance with regional labor regulations.

title: Technical Onboarding Manager (Customer Success & Tech Support) - $900 p/m + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

We're launching a 3-month book marketing and publicity campaign for a Christian author and are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Social Media Assistant to build and manage the author's presence across
, Instagram, and LinkedIn. This is a great opportunity for someone who loves faith-based content, understands social media platforms deeply, and wants consistent part-time work supporting a meaningful project.

, Instagram, and LinkedIn (bio, branding consistency, pinned content, links)

• Occasionally assist with light content creation (repurposing existing material into platform-specific formats, simple graphics, caption writing)

• Monitor comments and messages daily, responding warmly and promptly, or flagging items that need the author's/team's personal attention

• Actively grow engagement — following relevant accounts, engaging authentically in comments, using appropriate hashtags, and applying platform best practices to build reach

• Track basic performance metrics (likes, shares, comments, follower growth) and provide a simple weekly or bi-weekly summary

• Communicate proactively with the campaign lead about scheduling, content gaps, or ideas

What We're Looking For

• Excellent written English — clear, warm, and error-free, since you'll be posting and replying on behalf of the author

• Proven experience managing and growing social media pages, ideally for an author, ministry, coach, or personal brand

• Comfortable using scheduling tools (e.g., Buffer, Meta Business Suite, Later) — experience with Buffer specifically is a plus

• Basic video editing skills (CapCut, InShot, Premiere Rush, or similar) for trimming and formatting reels

• Understanding of what drives engagement on
, Instagram, and LinkedIn respectively — you know these are not “one post fits all three” platforms

• Reliable internet access and the ability to work independently with minimal daily supervision

• Genuine comfort with and respect for Christian/faith-based content and audiences

• Strong communication and time management — this role requires consistency, not just skill

Nice to Have

• Experience supporting an author, speaker, or ministry-related brand specifically

• Basic graphic design skills (Canva)

• Familiarity with Instagram/Facebook Reels trends and short-form video best practices

How to Apply

1. A brief note about your experience with social media management (especially any author, ministry, or personal brand accounts)

title: Social Media Engagement Manager
description:
Hi there, it's Sarah from Moonah Marketing - I'm looking for a Social Media Enagagement Manager to join my agency.  This will be a new role and I anticipate the role to include the following (but I'm open to your ideas):



1. Community Group Posting

- Posting in up to 15–20 approved 
munity groups per month

- Identifying relevant 
munity and industry groups from Moonah's database (refresh the database annually)

- Selecting suitable client posts each week

- Rewriting captions so they feel personal, helpful and appropriate to the community (avoiding identical copy being pasted across all groups)

- This should not simply be “posting into groups”. You should understand how to make the client appear like a genuine local business rather than a repetitive advertiser.



2. Account engagement and relationship building

- Engage with local businesses, customers and complementary accounts

- Leave thoughtful comments rather than generic comments such as “Great post!” or "Congratulations!"

- Participating in recommendation posts such as “Can anyone recommend a local cleaner?”

- Respond to people who mention, tag or recommend the client

- Thank customers who share photos, testimonials or positive feedback

- Reshare suitable customer-generated content

- Engage with local events, councils, community organisations and business networks (where applicable)

- Build relationships with potential referral partners (where applicable)

- Participate in relevant LinkedIn discussions for business-to-business clients (where applicable)



3. Comment and inbox monitoring

- Checking comments, messages, tags, mentions and
 reviews

- Responding to frequently asked questions using pre-approved answers and following up (where appropriate)

- Hiding or escalating spam, abusive comments and inappropriate content

- Identifying sales enquiries and passing them to the client promptly

- Flagging complaints, refund requests or sensitive matters and passing them to the client promptly

- Maintaining a response-time standard

- Recording commonly asked questions that could become future content (and liaising with Adriane on any trends you notice)



4. Follower growth

- Invite relevant people who have reacted to
 posts to follow the page

- Engage with local and industry accounts

- Identify opportunities for giveaways or community features (?)

- Suggest account optimisation improvements

- Monitor which activities are generating relevant followers

- Remove or report obvious fake and spam accounts where appropriate



The priority should be relevant local or industry followers, not vanity numbers.



5. Monthly Reporting

- Recording your activity each month (such as how many groups, posts, likes, comments, shares etc)

- Tracking which groups generate enquiries, clicks or engagement

- Maintaining a client-specific database of approved groups

- Monitoring whether posts are approved, declined or removed





6. Assist Moonah's Graphic Designer

- Asist with graphic design over-flow work including video editing (mainly Canva and CapCut)

We are an Australian marketing agency offering a range of services to our clients. Our clients come from all industries. I currently have 7 Filippino VAs on the team who all work remotely from home.  Due to the nature of our work and our remote team, the following attributes are imperative: honesty, great communication, fast turnaround times on jobs, working to the best of your ability, and getting results for our clients. We are a close-knit team and I am happy to provide you with the software, tools and support you need to succeed in this role.



To learn more about Moonah feel free to visit 
 or our 



This role will be on a casual basis (I anticipate 10 hours per week, give or take, with a view to growing), at $6AUD p/hr to start with.



If you have suitable experience and are keen to meet with me, please reach out!



Many thanks,

Sarah

title: Dental Sales & Lead Conversion (Remote)
description:
Compensation: Base salary (PHP) + commission per booked and attended consultation + performance bonuses

Start Date: ASAP



We run a high-end dental practices in Brisbane, Australia specialising in dental implants, full mouth rehabilitation, porcelain veneers, and complex cosmetic dentistry. We generate consistent inbound leads through
 and Instagram advertising, and we need a sharp, confident communicator to convert those leads into booked consultations.



This is a sales and coordination role, not a clinical one. You won't be doing dentistry. You will be the first human voice a potential patient hears and your job is to make that count.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

Responding to inbound leads within minutes of them coming through via SMS, phone call, and messaging platforms. Qualifying leads using a structured conversation framework to understand treatment interest, timeline, and financial readiness. Educating prospects on treatment options at a high level using provided scripts and materials. Overcoming objections, building rapport, and guiding patients toward booking a consultation. Following up consistently with warm leads who haven't yet committed. Logging all activity and lead status accurately in our CRM (GoHighLevel). Coordinating with our in-clinic team to ensure smooth handovers for booked patients.



What We're Looking For

You either have a background in dentistry, dental reception, or healthcare coordination or you're someone who learns fast and takes the time to genuinely understand what we offer before picking up the phone.



You have a clear, neutral, or near-Australian/American accent. This is non-negotiable. Our patients are Australian and the communication needs to feel natural and credible from the first word.



You're a confident communicator who doesn't shy away from discussing money. Our treatments range from $5,000 to $60,000+. You need to be comfortable having that conversation calmly and without hesitation.



You're hungry. The commission structure rewards results, and if you're good at this, your earning potential here is significant.



You're organised and self-directed. We're not managing you minute-to-minute. You'll be given a system, scripts, and leads - your job is to execute.



Required

Excellent spoken and written English, with a clear neutral, Australian-adjacent, or American accent. 

Proven experience in a sales, customer service, or patient coordination role. 

Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional environment for calls. 

Comfort using CRM software (GoHighLevel experience is a bonus, not a requirement). 

Availability during Australian business hours (and after-hours / weekends)



Preferred

Experience in dental reception, treatment coordination, or medical/healthcare administration. Familiarity with dental terminology - implants, veneers, All-on-X, etc. Prior remote sales experience with a performance-based compensation structure.



Compensation Structure

Competitive base salary (commensurate with experience). Commission paid per consultation that books and attends. Additional bonuses tied to monthly performance targets. Exact figures discussed at interview stage — the structure is designed to reward people who perform.



How to Apply

Record a short 60-90 second video introducing yourself, explaining your relevant experience, and demonstrating your spoken English. Include this with your application along with your CV. 



Applications without a voice or video sample will not be reviewed.

JLX Entertainment is a premium events entertainment company delivering DJ, MC, and live music experiences for weddings, corporate functions, and private events across Melbourne and beyond. We're a fast-moving, high-volume operation with a strong brand, a growing roster of talent, and a client experience standard we take seriously. This role sits at the centre of that experience.

Role Overview

The Administration & Client Concierge Coordinator is the operational backbone of JLX Entertainment's client and talent experience. You are the first and most consistent touchpoint for booked clients — the “online concierge” who ensures every client feels supported, informed, and organised from booking through to event delivery.

You will manage all front-end client correspondence, keep 100+ active clients moving smoothly through their event pipeline, coordinate talent paperwork and scheduling, and own the administrative systems that keep the business running. Your job is to handle the details so the Director and sales team can focus on high-value conversations and event delivery.

This is not a sales or lead qualification role — leads are qualified by our sales team. Your role begins once a client is booked in, and your job is to make everything after that point seamless.

Key Responsibilities

Client Correspondence & Concierge Support

• Act as the primary point of contact for all booked client enquiries via

• Answer client questions regarding service hours, inclusions, and booking details

• Filter and manage inbound correspondence so that only decision-required matters reach the Director or sales team

• Uphold the principle that no decisions are made over
 — schedule clients into calls with the appropriate tea
mber when decisions or detailed discussions are needed

• Ensure every client interaction reflects JLX's premium brand standard

Pipeline & Client Management

• Manage 50–100 new leads per month entering the system, ensuring each is placed and progressed correctly

• Maintain accurate pipeline stages for 100+ active clients based on where they sit relative to their event date

• Monitor client touchpoints and proactively manage follow-ups, ensuring no client falls through the cracks despite irregular contact rhythms

• Prepare client details and context ahead of scheduled calls so the team walks in fully informed

Talent Administration

• Prepare and send all talent paperwork (booking confirmations, agreements, event details)

• Set up and manage calendar invites for talent across all booked events

• Ensure talent have complete, accurate, and timely information for every engagement

Calendar & Scheduling

• Manage the Director's calendar, including client calls, talent bookings, and internal commitments

• Schedule client calls with the sales team and Director as required

• Coordinate scheduling across multiple events and stakeholders without conflicts

Database & Systems Administration

• Maintain accurate records across Google Sheets (including the DJ database), Google Drive, and Google Calendar

• Keep event folders, client information, and booking data organised and up to date

• Execute recurring administrative processes and identify opportunities to streamline them

Skills & Experience Required

• 2+ years' experience in an administration, coordination, executive assistant, or client service role

• Exceptional written communication — professional, warm, and clear
 correspondence is the core of this role

• Strong proficiency with Google Workspace (Sheets, Drive, Calendar, Gmail)

• Proven ability to manage high volumes of concurrent clients, tasks, or bookings without dropping details

• Excellent organisational skills and a systems-oriented mindset

• Comfortable working autonomously and taking full ownership of administrative outcomes

• Sound judgement on what to handle independently versus what to escalate

Nice to Have

• Experience in events, entertainment, hospitality, or weddings

• Familiarity with CRM platforms (e.g. GoHighLevel or similar)

• Experience supporting a founder or small business owner directly

• Understanding of client lifecycle or pipeline management

What Success Looks Like

• Clients consistently feel looked after — questions answered promptly, details always correct

• The Director's inbox and calendar run themselves; only genuine decisions reach his desk

• Every client is in the right pipeline stage at the right time, with zero clients slipping through the cracks

• Talent paperwork and calendars are always accurate, complete, and sent on time

• The sales team and Director walk into every call fully briefed

Why Join JLX

You'll be joining a growing entertainment brand with a clear vision, working directly with the founder in a role with real ownership and impact. This is a position for someone who takes pride in being the person who keeps everything running — the one everyone relies on.

title: Lead Generation & Email Marketing Specialist

Job Description:



This role is for a technically-minded builder who uses AI and automation to run marketing systems, not a marketer who is still learning these tools. The successful candidate will be hired and managed by P1peline and work full-time with The Move Better Project (TMBP), one of Australia's leading custom apparel companies.



The role owns two areas from day one:
 marketing, and lead generation through web scraping and data collection. It is responsible for building and running the systems that grow TMBP's
 database, generate qualified leads, and feed their Australian sales team a steady pipeline of prospects. Once these are built out, the role will expand into paid advertising on Meta and Google.



The owner wants someone who can work from objectives with little day-to-day management. That means asking the right questions to lock down requirements, designing your own solutions, and delivering results. The right person is good with software, strong at prompt engineering, and able to connect AI tools with the platforms and other tools the company already uses.



Core Responsibilities:



1.
 Marketing — Primary Focus



Take full ownership of TMBP's
 marketing, including automations, campaigns, and reporting. TMBP currently uses Klaviyo.

• Plan and send campaigns: weekly EDMs, product launches, event promotions, customer stories, educational content, and promotional campaigns

• Manage audience segmentation, A/B testing, and deliverability

• Report on
 revenue and engagement, and continuously improve performance



2. Web Scraping & Lead Generation — Primary Focus



Own the process of finding, collecting, and organizing prospect data to grow TMBP's sales pipeline. Use automation and AI tools to do this at scale.



Research and identify targets such as:

• CrossFit affiliates, functional fitness gyms, HYROX affiliates, strength & conditioning facilities, independent gyms, and boutique studios

• Sporting organisations, schools, universities, sporting clubs, competitions, and events

Collect publicly available business information:

, phone number, social media profiles, and key decision makers where publicly available



Build and maintain clean prospect databases for TMBP's Australian sales team, and research industry trends, competitor activity, new gym openings, and partnership or sponsorship opportunities.



3. Paid Advertising (Meta & Google) — Growth Phase



Once the
 lists and lead pipeline are built out, the role will grow into managing paid advertising. This is where the role expands over time, not where it starts.

• Google: Search, Performance Max, Display, and Remarketing, including keyword research, conversion tracking, and budget allocation



4. Reporting



Deliver accurate weekly reports covering
 revenue and engagement, lead generation, and cost per lead, plus paid ad performance once campaigns are running. Make clear recommendations for improvement.



Requirements

• Strong with software. Comfortable building and integrating systems, not just using them.

• Strong prompt engineering to get the best results from AI tools

 marketing skills. Experience with Klaviyo is a major bonus, but most
 platforms are similar, so the skill set matters more than the specific software.

, using AI tools to support

• Able to collaborate with and advise the founder on how best to achieve his objectives

Ideal Candidate:

title: Production & Sourcing Manager
description:
ABOUT GRUNT STUDIOS



Grunt Studios is a Los Angeles-based execution studio that partners with founders to build and scale brands — strategy, branding, content, and product/production. We're not a traditional agency: we sell outcomes, not hours, and take equity positions alongside select clients. Our merchandise and supply chain arm covers everything from domestic cut-and-sew, print, and embroidery to overseas apparel, hard goods, and accessories sourcing.



THE ROLE



We're looking for a Production & Sourcing Manager to take ownership of our production pipeline — both domestic manufacturing and overseas sourcing — and become the primary point of contact between our suppliers and our clients. Right now, that role is filled by our co-founder, which means every supplier detail and every client confirmation runs through one person. We need someone who can own that relationship end-to-end: negotiate with vendors, catch spec and tech pack issues before they become problems, and confirm final details with clients without needing sign-off on every line item.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



- Manage day-to-day communication with domestic (blanks, print, embroidery) and overseas (apparel, hard goods, accessories) suppliers

- Review tech packs and specs for accuracy before they go to production — catch errors independently, not after the fact

- Track proto, fit, PP, and TOP sample rounds through to approval

- Negotiate cost, lead time, and terms with vendors, and flag landed-cost impacts

- Confirm production details and timelines directly with clients, escalating only true judgment calls

- Maintain PO status, production trackers, and spec libraries so nothing lives only in
 threads

- Flag quality issues and manage the resolution process with suppliers



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Within 90 days, our co-founder is no longer the default point of contact for supplier communication or client confirmations on active production — you are. Judgment calls come to leadership as recommendations, not open questions.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



3+ years in apparel/merchandise production or sourcing, ideally at a DTC brand, manufacturer, or sourcing agency

Fluent in the language of the trade: POMs, tech packs, Incoterms, cut-and-sew, proto/fit/PP/TOP sample cycles

Track record managing both domestic manufacturing partners and overseas vendors

Comfortable negotiating cost and terms directly with suppliers

Sharp, detail-obsessed communicator who can represent production status clearly to non-technical clients

Able to work independently and make calls without waiting for approval on every decision



NICE TO HAVE



Existing relationships with domestic print/embroidery/cut-and-sew vendors or overseas factories

Experience with landed-cost modeling and QC processes (e.g., QIMA, Pro QC, SGS)

Background at a brand accelerator, agency, or multi-client production environment

title: Customer Service Representative/Manager
description:
Customer Service Representative (Growth to CS Manager)



About Us



We are a fast-growing e-commerce brand. We're building a small, tight team — not a call center. As we grow (and we plan to add more stores), the person in this role has a real path to becoming our Customer Service Manager: hiring, training, and running the CS function across the brand(s).



This isn't a "clock in, answer
s, clock out" job. We're hiring someone we intend to work closely with, trust, and grow with.



How We Work Together (read this before applying)

This matters as much as the skills section below, so we're putting it first.



- We do a weekly 1:1 check-in — not a formality, an actual conversation about what's working, what's not, and where you're stuck.

- We give direct feedback often, including small corrections. We expect you to take it well, ask questions, and adjust — not push back or get defensive.

- We're building a long-term working relationship, not just filling a ticket queue. If you prefer to be left alone with zero check-ins, this isn't the right fit.

- Good CS is 50% skill, 50% how you communicate with us and with customers. We weigh both equally.



The Role



Phase 1 — CS Representative

- Handle inbound customer service
s for a fashion store

- Resolve returns, refunds, damaged items, order inquiries, and complaints, following our SOPs

- Target response time: under 4 hours during business hours

- Escalate complex cases with clear notes

- Learn our products, policies, and resolution procedures thoroughly

- General Supplier communication



Phase 2 — CS Manager (earned through performance, not just time with us)

- Hire, train, and manage additional CS reps as we scale

- Own quality control — review responses, catch gaps, improve SOPs

- Update SOPs as new stores/niches are added

- Report on CS metrics to leadership

- Be the first point of escalation before issues reach me directly

- Update and create new KPI's

- Share Ideas for real growth and become a key operator to our business

- Advanced Supplier communication (Weekly updates on what products have issues, communicate where things are going wrong shipping wise, and how we can improve with our suppliers)





Is This You? (read before applying — saves us both time)



This is written, async e-commerce support —
 tickets through a helpdesk, not phone calls, not live chat, not account management.



This is probably NOT a fit if your experience is:

- Phone or call-center support (voice de-escalation and script-reading are different skills from writing a calibrated
 offer over several days)

- B2B account management or client success (low-volume, high-touch, relationship-based — this role is high-volume ticket triage with strangers)

- Purely in-house retail or non-e-commerce CS with no returns/refunds component



This IS a fit if you've done:

-
/ticket-based support for an online store (Shopify, WooCommerce, or similar) — dropshipping experience especially

- Handling returns, refunds, "item not as described" disputes, or shipping-delay complaints in writing

- Working inside a helpdesk tool (Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Re:amaze, or similar) rather than a phone queue



Required:

- At least 1 year of e-commerce, ticket-based customer service experience — dropshipping strongly preferred

- Excellent written English — clear, professional, empathetic, and fast to type

- Comfortable handling refund/return negotiations in writing, following a structured offer ladder (we'll train you on our specific SOP, but you should already understand why stores do this, not be learning the concept from scratch)

- Strong attention to detail — you'll follow specific SOPs and every step matters

- Reliable internet and availability during US business hours

- Comfortable receiving direct feedback and course-correcting quickly, without taking it personally

- Self-starter, but also genuinely wants regular check-ins and collaboration — not someone who wants to be handed a task and never spoken to again

- Experience in supplier communication



Big plus:

- Direct experience with dropshipping-specific issues: long shipping times, China-warehouse returns, chargeback prevention, supplier communication

- Experience with Shopify, Gorgias, Zendesk, or similar tools

- Prior experience training or supervising others



Compensation

We pay in tiers tied to real milestones and performance — Here's the full ladder upfront:



Phase 1 — CS Rep | Handles tickets, follows SOPs | $2.00–4.50/hr, depending on experience |

Phase 1.5 — Senior Rep | Faster/harder tickets, input on QA, trusted on edge cases | $5–6/hr |

Phase 2 — CS Manager | Hires/trains/manages reps, owns SOPs, reports directly to leadership | Raised set monthly salary |



Review checkpoints at 30 / 60 / 90 days. Movement between tiers is based on clear, agreed criteria at each checkpoint — not a mood or a favor. We'll tell you exactly what's needed to move up before you get there.



- We're upfront: if a specific number is a dealbreaker for you today, let's talk about it before you apply, not three months in.



How to Apply

Send all of the following. Incomplete applications won't be reviewed.



1. A short introduction — who you are, your relevant experience, and why this role (not just any CS job) interests you. Please specifically name: the helpdesk/ticketing tool you used in your most relevant past role, and roughly how many tickets you handled per day. (If your background is phone support or account management rather than
/ticket support, please say so directly — it may still be worth discussing, but we want to know upfront rather than find out later.)



2. Write out, in full, how you'd respond to this customer
:

 "I ordered a dress 3 weeks ago and it looks completely different from the photos. The color is way off and I want a full refund. I'm going to leave a bad review everywhere if this isn't resolved today."



3. Tell us about a time someone corrected your work or gave you feedback you initially disagreed with. What happened, and how did you handle it? (Be specific and honest — this matters more to us than a perfect answer.)



4. Your availability — confirm you can work US business hours, and list any blackout dates in the next 30 days.



We look forward to your responses

Regards,

MS INDUSTRIES

title: TRUST ELITE CLEANING SOLUTIONS VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — CLEANING BUSINESS OPERATIONS Full Time | Pacific Standard Time | Long
description:
TRUST ELITE CLEANING SOLUTIONS

EVENING/NIGHT OPERATIONS SPECIALIST — CLEANING INDUSTRY EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

Full Time | Pacific Standard Time | Long-Term Career Position | Pay Negotiable for the Right Person



---



## WHO WE ARE



Trust Elite Cleaning Solutions is a professional cleaning company serving Los Angeles and the San Bernardino / Inland Empire markets in Southern California. We handle residential and commercial accounts. We use Jobber for all operations, Slack as our command center, and QUO for phones. Everything runs through systems — your job is to keep those systems moving, close out leads, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks after the daytime team goes home.



We run Google LSA into the evening, which means real leads come in late — and every one of them needs a fast, sharp, professional response before we close out for the night. That's what this role exists to own.



---



## READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY



**If you have not personally worked FOR a cleaning company — not just used a CRM, not just "know the industry," not just done admin work somewhere adjacent — do not apply.** We need someone who has actually sat in a cleaning company's operations seat before: taken cleaning leads, quoted cleaning jobs, dispatched cleaners, and handled real cleaning clients. If that is not your background, this posting is not for you, and your application will not be reviewed.



We are looking for a mature, experienced, dependable professional with a minimum of 5 years of real work experience. We need someone who has been through real workplace challenges and knows how to handle them without hand-holding. Maturity, professional stability, and reliability matter more to us than anything else.



This is not an entry-level position and not a "figure it out as you go" role.



---



## REQUIREMENTS — NON-NEGOTIABLE



You MUST meet all of the following or do not apply:



- Minimum 5 years of professional work experience

- **Direct, hands-on experience working FOR a cleaning company** — quoting, scheduling, dispatching, or managing cleaning clients. Home services experience in a different trade does not meet this requirement.

- Currently working or has worked evening/night Pacific Standard Time (PST) hours — 5:00 PM to 11:00 PM PST — for at least 1 year

- Comfortable with sales — confident closing leads over phone and text, not just answering questions and waiting

- Knows how to use Jobber or a similar field service CRM such as Housecall Pro or ServiceTitan

- Working knowledge of Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365

- Fluent in English — written and spoken — professional level

- Reliable high-speed internet connection

- Quiet, professional workspace at home

- Stable work history — no job hopping

- Willing and able to rotate schedule/days as the company grows — this is not a fixed, unchanging shift forever

- Available to start within 2 weeks



---



## TOOLS YOU MUST KNOW OR LEARN IMMEDIATELY



- Jobber — quoting, booking, dispatching, invoicing

- Slack — primary communication tool, you will live here

- QUO / OpenPhone — answering calls and texts, managing inbox

- Google LSA — responding to leads, managing the lead inbox

- Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Teams —
, meetings, SharePoint document management

- PandaDoc — sending contracts and onboarding documents

- Basic Zapier understanding is a plus



---



## YOUR DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES



Every single evening you are responsible for:



**LEAD MANAGEMENT & SALES**

- Monitor Google LSA inbox starting at 5:00 PM PST sharp

- Respond to every new lead within 15 minutes of it coming in

- Sell, don't just quote — build trust fast, create urgency, and close the job

- Use the company pricing tool to generate accurate quotes every time — never guess a price

- Follow up on all unanswered quotes within 24 hours

- Log every lead in Slack #leads with lead ID and dollar amount



**JOBBER OPERATIONS**

- Create new client profiles for every approved lead

- Build and send quotes in Jobber using the correct templates

- Convert approved quotes to jobs and schedule them correctly

- Assign cleaners to jobs and confirm their availability first

- Add complete job instructions including entry codes, parking, scope of work, and any special instructions

- Monitor job status throughout the evening — check-ins, completions

- Follow up on any job that has not been marked complete on time



**CLIENT COMMUNICATION**

- Respond to all client texts and calls through QUO professionally

- Handle rescheduling, cancellations, and schedule changes

- Escalate any client complaints to ownership immediately

- Never discuss pricing changes or make promises without approval



**SLACK ACCOUNTABILITY**

- Post your daily check-in by 5:00 PM PST every workday

- Confirm every completed task in the assigned Slack channels

- Respond to all Slack messages within 15 minutes during work hours

- Post any issues, problems, or questions in the correct channel immediately — do not wait



**CLEANER COORDINATION**

- Send job assignments to cleaners through Jobber

- Follow up if a cleaner has not checked in within 15 minutes of their scheduled start time

- Notify ownership immediately of any no-shows or problems

- Send onboarding documents through PandaDoc to new cleaners and follow up until all documents are returned signed



---



## WHAT IS NOT ACCEPTABLE — READ THIS CAREFULLY



The following will result in immediate termination:



- Not responding to leads within 15 minutes during work hours

- Sending a quote with a price that was not generated from the company pricing tool

- Missing the 5:00 PM PST daily check-in without prior notice

- Not answering Slack messages during work hours

- Making promises to clients without ownership approval

- Logging off early without permission

- Not logging leads, quotes, or completed tasks in Slack

- Blaming cleaners or clients for errors that were your responsibility

- Dishonesty of any kind — about tasks completed, client interactions, or cleaner performance



---



## HOURS AND SCHEDULE



- Monday through Saturday — 5:00 PM to 11:00 PM PST required

- Sunday — occasional coverage may be needed

- As the company grows, you may be asked to rotate into different days or shift times — flexibility here is part of the job, and part of how you grow into more responsibility

- You are expected to be at your desk and available during all scheduled hours — not semi-available



This is a Pacific Standard Time evening/night role. If you cannot commit to these PST evening hours, do not apply.



---



## PAY — NEGOTIABLE FOR THE RIGHT PERSON



We are not hiring on price — we are hiring on quality. Pay is based on your real experience, your sales ability, and your cleaning industry background, and we are open to paying more for someone who is genuinely excellent at this.



Pay is weekly via Wise or direct transfer. Performance reviews at 30 days and 90 days, with room to negotiate again as you prove yourself.



---



## GROWTH OPPORTUNITY — THIS IS THE PART THAT MATTERS



We are building this company for the long term, and we are not looking to fill a seat — we are looking for someone to grow with us. If you are the right person — reliable, sharp, experienced, and genuinely good at sales and operations — there is real room to grow into a senior operations role, take on more responsibility, rotate into new parts of the business, and negotiate real pay increases as you prove your value.



We are not looking for someone to do the bare minimum. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their role and treats this business like it's theirs too — because the right person will be treated that way.



---



## HOW TO APPLY



To be considered you must include ALL of the following in your application or it will not be reviewed:



1. Your full name

2. How many years of total professional work experience you have

3. Confirm you are available 5pm-11pm PST Monday through Saturday

4. **Describe, in detail, the cleaning company you worked for and exactly what you did daily** — quoting, scheduling, dispatching, client communication, sales. Be specific. Vague answers will be rejected.

5. List every CRM or field service tool you have used such as Jobber, Housecall Pro, or ServiceTitan

6. Tell us about your sales experience — closing leads, handling objections, converting quotes into booked jobs

7. Tell us what PST evening/night hours you have worked previously and for how long

8. Write this exact sentence at the top of your application so we know you read the entire post:

   "I have read all requirements and I meet every one of them, including direct cleaning company experience."



Applications that do not include all 8 items, or that cannot show direct cleaning company experience, will not be reviewed.



---



Trust Elite Cleaning Solutions

Los Angeles, California

(818)

title: Interior Design Drafter (AutoCAD + SketchUp), Detail-Obsessed (Remote, US Team)
description:
About us:

We're Roberts & Lamb, a high-end residential interior design studio based in Utah with projects nationwide. We design beautiful, detailed homes for great clients, and we're growing. We're a small, tight team that cares deeply about craft and precision. You'd work directly with our principal and designers at their right hand — turning vision into clean, accurate drawings and buttoned-up spec packages.



What you'll do

- Drafting & drawing (the core of the role): produce clean, accurate floor plans, elevations, and construction drawings in AutoCAD and other tools; build 3D layouts and furniture space plans in SketchUp.

- Turn a designer's rough sketch or markup into a precise, scaled drawing.

- Build and maintain FF&E spec packages — schedules, spec sheets, product data — organized in spreadsheets, slides, and our project system.

- Create renderings and clean up client-facing presentation decks.

- Support sourcing: find product options, enter data, flag dimension/fit issues, handle reselections when items are out of stock.

- Keep files, schedules, and vendor trackers accurate and up to date.



This role runs on a ~4-hour daily overlap with US Mountain Time (about 10 PM–2 AM Manila); the rest of your hours are flexible. Please only apply if that works for you long-term.



Who you are

- Heavy drawing capability — this is the heart of the job. You are genuinely strong in AutoCAD and SketchUp and can prove it. (Revit and rendering tools like Enscape/V-Ray are a plus.)

- Technically skilled — comfortable across the design-production stack; Google Workspace; spreadsheets for specs; quick to learn our tools.

- Obsessively detail-oriented — dimensions are right, specs are complete, nothing is "close enough." You catch the small errors before anyone else does.

- A self-starter — give you a goal and context and you run with it. You make sensible calls when details are thin instead of freezing or waiting to be told.

- Sharp written English — you communicate clearly; you'll be collaborating live with the team.

- Interior design background — a design degree and real production experience at a design or architecture firm.



Why this is a good seat

- Real craft on beautiful projects, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the people who care equally about excellence.

- A team that values precision and treats you like part of it.

- Stable, long-term, full-time — we want someone for the long arc, with room to grow as we do.



Our process (so there's no guessing):

- Apply here, following the instructions below.

- If it's a potential fit, we send a short form (~10 minutes).

- Strong applicants get one short practical task (~45 minutes): a small drawing + spec exercise, plus a quick Loom walking us through it.

- A live interview with the team.

- Offer (we may start with a short paid trial project).



The whole thing is designed to be fast and respectful of your time. We tell you where you stand at each step.



How to apply — read this part carefully.

- Start your application with the exact phrase: "I draw with precision."

- In your first two sentences, confirm you can work the ~4-hour daily overlap (about 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM Manila) long-term, and tell us whether you've worked with a US team before and for how long.

- Then briefly answer: What's one drawing or spec package you're proud of — what made it good, and how did you make sure it was accurate?

- Tell us your specific experience with AutoCAD and SketchUp (what have you actually produced?), plus any Revit, rendering, or FF&E/spec experience.

- Include a link to your portfolio. We especially want to see technical work — floor plans, elevations, construction drawings, and spec/FF&E sheets — not only finished renders. If your best drafting samples aren't in your main portfolio, add a few.



Applications that don't begin with "I draw with precision." will not be read. We pay attention to detail, and so should you.

title: Accounting Executive
description:
About Scriveiner

Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories. Founded in 2019, our products are used by millions of customers worldwide, available via major online marketplaces and from more than 1,000 retail stores around the globe. Our mission is simple: to create beautiful, high-quality products that people love to use every day.



The company has grown rapidly and has been recognised with numerous awards, including the King’s Award for Enterprise, The Sunday Times 100, the Great British Entrepreneur Awards, and multiple international design awards.



Scriveiner is the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led business focused on building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are high-growth, entrepreneurial and hands-on, and we are focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences.





The Opportunity

Scriveiner is at a pivotal point in its growth expanding into new premium product categories, scaling its Amazon and Shopify channels, and building the operational infrastructure to support a significant step-change over the next three years. As the business grows, so does the need for a finance function that is not just accurate, but sharp.



We are hiring an Accounting Executive to sit at the operational core of the Finance team. This is a role for someone who understands UK accounting deeply, works confidently without a manual, and brings the kind of proactive judgment that means problems get spotted before they become problems. The Finance Manager is looking for someone who improves how the function works not just someone who keeps pace with it.



Day to day, you will own the transactional engine of the business: AP, AR, bank reconciliations, VAT, month-end close, and the accuracy behind every financial report we produce. But the expectation goes further than execution. You will look at how we do things, identify where they can be tighter, and take genuine ownership of the financial integrity of a lean, fast-moving business. The systems you help build now will underpin Scriveiner at twice its current size.



What You Will Own

Own the accuracy and completeness of daily financial transactions, AP, AR, invoicing, and payment runs ensuring every entry is correctly authorised, coded, and filed

Lead bank and supplier reconciliations, resolving discrepancies proactively rather than waiting for month-end to surface them

Take full ownership of VAT preparation and filing support, maintaining compliance with UK regulations

Drive month-end and year-end close activities, moving the process forward with minimal direction

Maintain clean audit trails across all financial records digital and physical so documentation is always ready, not assembled at the last minute

Identify gaps and inefficiencies in current financial processes and bring forward practical improvements you are expected to flag what is not working and suggest what should replace it

Support the preparation of management accounts, P&L summaries, cash flow reports, and balance sheet reconciliations that the Finance Manager and founders can rely on

Liaise with internal teams and external suppliers on financial queries, acting as a reliable point of contact who resolves issues without escalation

Contribute to forecasting and budgeting inputs as the business plans for growth across new product categories and marketplaces

Perform intercompany reconciliations, ensuring transactions between business entities are accurately recorded and resolved in a timely manner

Assist in the preparation of divisional profit and loss accounts, supporting clear visibility of performance across the business

Ensure correct expense allocation across business divisions, maintaining accuracy and consistency in how costs are assigned and reported





Who You Are

Essential — you must have this:

Solid, hands-on UK accounting experience you understand VAT, AP/AR workflows, reconciliations, and month-end close as second nature

Proven proficiency with at least one major accounting platform: Xero, QuickBooks, or Sage

Strong Excel skills: pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and basic data modelling without needing to be shown

A track record of working independently, you manage your own workload, flag risks early, and do not require close supervision to maintain accuracy

A genuine drive to improve how a finance function works, not just maintain it  you notice inefficiencies and act on them

High attention to detail with a professional approach to confidentiality and financial data

Experience working within a business with a turnover of £10 million or more





Desirable — it would strengthen your application if you have this:

Familiarity with e-commerce accounting, particularly Amazon Seller Central or Shopify financial flows

Experience working in a small or scaling business where finance is a lean, high-ownership function

Exposure to multi-currency transactions or international marketplace accounting





What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will be successful when:

Financial records are consistently accurate, up to date, and audit-ready without prompting

Bank and supplier reconciliations are completed on time with discrepancies identified and resolved proactively

VAT filings and compliance obligations are met without error or delay

Month-end close is completed efficiently, with reports the Finance Manager and founders can rely on

You bring forward at least one meaningful improvement to financial processes or systems within your first 90 days

The Finance Manager spends less time checking and more time using the information you produce



HOW TO APPLY

Fill out the form here: 



Please note that candidates with UK accounting experience will be given preference during the selection process.

title: Inventory Assistant
description:
ABOUT SCRIVEINER LONDON

Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories.

Founded in 2019, our products are used by millions of customers worldwide, available via major online marketplaces and from more than 1,000 retail stores around the globe. Our mission is simple: to create beautiful, high-quality products that people love to use every day.

The company has grown rapidly and has been recognised with numerous awards, including the King’s Award for Enterprise, The Sunday Times 100, the Great British Entrepreneur Awards, and multiple international design awards.

Scriveiner is the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led business focused on building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are high-growth, entrepreneurial and hands-on, and we are focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences.





THE OPPORTUNITY

As Inventory Assistant, you will work at the operational heart of the Inventory team, keeping stock records accurate, Amazon FBA running cleanly, and our third-party logistics partners on track. This is not a passive role. You will be the person who catches discrepancies before they become customer problems, flags low stock before it becomes a lost sale, and ensures that every shipment entering or leaving the warehouse is accounted for correctly.



The role covers the full operational breadth of inventory management: from daily stock reconciliation across the IM Sheet and Power BI dashboards, to managing Amazon Seller Central shipments and processing FBA reimbursements, to coordinating with 3PL partners on inbound and outbound fulfilment. New product launches, including wallets, notebooks, and leather accessories targeting Q3 2026, will add meaningful scope and pace to the role over the coming months.



If you are someone who finds genuine satisfaction in a clean reconciliation, who catches errors others walk past, and who wants to understand how a premium e-commerce brand actually operates end-to-end, this role will give you exactly that.





WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Stock Management and Control

Maintain accurate, up-to-date inventory records across the IM Sheet, Power BI dashboards, and all active e-commerce platforms — these records are the operational source of truth for the business

Update and manage stock levels on the Faire and Turis wholesale platforms, ensuring availability is always reflected correctly for trade buyers

Conduct regular cycle counts, spot checks, and full stocktakes; investigate and resolve discrepancies, variances, and shrinkage before they escalate

Monitor stock levels proactively and flag low-inventory or overstock situations to the Inventory Manager



Order Management and 3PL Coordination

Import and process orders into 3PL partner systems, double-checking previous orders for unfulfilled or incomplete items

Prepare and coordinate retail orders for dispatch, liaising with 3PL partners to ensure timely and accurate fulfilment

Process incoming shipments from suppliers and freight carriers, verifying quantities and quality, resolving delivery discrepancies, and updating stock records accurately



Amazon Seller Central and FBA Operations

Create and manage Amazon FBA shipments end-to-end in Seller Central, including video verification, status tracking, and updating the Shipment Status File

Process FBA reimbursement claims for missing or lost units, maintaining accurate dispute records



Reporting and Compliance

Prepare and distribute the OD Weekly Report; update, file, and manage OD dispute records for compliance charges and discrepancies

Generate inventory reports and variance summaries using the IM Sheet and Power BI

Support the Inventory Manager with inventory data for seasonal demand forecasting and buying decisions

Perform other ad hoc tasks as directed by the Inventory Manager or wider Operations team



WHO YOU ARE

Essential

Hands-on experience in an inventory, warehousing, or retail operations role — you have worked with stock, reconciled records, and managed order processes in a real operational environment

Confident working with inventory management tools and reporting platforms, whether that is a WMS, ERP, IM Sheet, or Power BI in combination

Practical experience with Amazon Seller Central and FBA processes, including shipment creation and account management

Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail — you catch errors in data that others overlook, and you find reconciliation satisfying rather than tedious

Competent in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for reporting, data management, and variance analysis

A proactive communicator who flags issues early rather than waiting to be asked



Desirable

Experience with wholesale platforms such as Faire and/or Turis

Familiarity with 3PL order management, fulfilment workflows, and inbound shipment processing

Experience handling Amazon compliance charges, disputes, and FBA reimbursement claims

Understanding of FIFO stock rotation principles and inventory control best practices

Experience using AI tools to improve operational workflows or reporting efficiency





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In this role, you will be successful when:

Inventory records across all platforms are accurate and current, with discrepancies investigated and resolved promptly.

Amazon FBA shipments are created, verified, and tracked without errors, and reimbursement claims are filed on time.

3PL orders are processed accurately, with fulfilment issues identified and escalated before they affect customers.

The OD Weekly Report and compliance records are maintained consistently and without prompting.

The Inventory Manager can rely on your data to make confident stock and buying decisions.



HOW TO APPLY:

Please fill out a form here:
