title: Website Operations Lead
description:
Part-Time to Start | 90-Day Contractor Trial | Opportunity for Growth



We Need an Owner, Not Just a Developer



This is not a typical web developer position.



We are not looking for someone who simply completes assigned tickets and moves on. We need a technically capable, highly responsible person who will take ownership of the health and functionality of our clients’ websites.



We are looking for someone who naturally thinks:

“I will investigate this, figure out what needs to happen, and make sure it is fully resolved.”

If that sounds like you, please keep reading.



About Us

We are an established digital marketing and website management agency specializing in independent lodging businesses, including boutique hotels, inns, bed and breakfasts, lodges, and vacation rentals throughout the United States.

We are a small, collaborative remote team. Several members of our team have worked with us for many years. We value initiative, communication, reliability, kindness, and people who genuinely care about doing good work.

We do not believe in micromanaging capable people. We give our tea
mbers room to grow, make decisions, and take ownership of their responsibilities.



Why This Position Exists

We do not simply need another developer.

We need someone who wakes up thinking:

“Are all our client websites healthy and functioning properly?”



Our clients depend on their websites to generate reservations, inquiries, wedding leads, gift certificate sales, and revenue. A website that looks fine but has a broken form, booking link, integration, or tracking system is not functioning properly.

You will be responsible for making sure website issues are investigated, assigned, repaired, tested, documented, and fully resolved.



Sometimes you will fix the issue yourself.

Sometimes you will assign or coordinate work with another developer or platform specialist.

Either way, you will remain responsible for the final outcome.



Websites and Platforms

Our client websites operate on several platforms, including:

• WordPress

• Shopify

• SilverStripe

• ThinkWeb

• Proprietary hospitality website platforms

• Custom and legacy website systems



You do not need to be an expert developer in every platform.

You do need to be technically curious, resourceful, comfortable learning unfamiliar systems, and willing to dig into a problem rather than immediately declaring that it belongs to someone else.



Primary Responsibility

Your primary responsibility will be:

To ensure that every website under our management is functional, monitored, maintained, tested, documented, and properly supported.



What You Will Do



Website Monitoring and Maintenance

• Monitor client websites for uptime, visible errors, security concerns, SSL problems, broken links, and other technical issues.

• Ensure website platforms, plugins, themes, and software are updated safely.

• Confirm that website backups are running and can be accessed when needed.

• Monitor hosting accounts, domains, DNS configurations, and related website services.

• Identify outdated software, unsupported integrations, and potential technical risks.

• Maintain an organized schedule for recurring website maintenance and audits.



Form and Functionality Testing

• Test contact, inquiry, wedding, event, newsletter, reservation, and other lead-generating forms.

• Confirm that submissions are delivered successfully to the correct recipients.

• Troubleshoot SMTP,
 delivery, notification, routing, and spam-filtering problems.

• Test booking links, phone links,
 links, calls to action, redirects, and confirmation messages.

• Verify that important website functions work correctly on desktop and mobile devices.

• Establish a recurring testing schedule so problems are discovered before clients report them.



Technical Troubleshooting

• Investigate reported website issues and determine their likely cause.

• Reproduce problems before assigning or attempting repairs.

• Resolve routine issues involving website platforms, plugins, themes, hosting, DNS, forms,
 delivery, analytics, tracking, and integrations.

• Research unfamiliar platforms and technical systems.

• Determine what can be resolved internally and what requires a specialist.

• Continue following each issue until the repair is completed and independently verified.



Quality Assurance

• Review website maintenance and development work before tasks are closed.

• Confirm that completed work functions correctly and matches the original request.

• Check whether a change may have affected other website functions.

• Review new pages and website updates for links, forms, layout problems, mobile responsiveness, and basic usability.

• Require revisions when work does not pass QA.

• Never assume that a task is complete simply because someone says it is complete.



Workflow and Team Coordination

• Manage and prioritize the technical website task queue.

• Write clear and complete technical assignments.

• Coordinate work with internal developers, contractors, and outside platform specialists.

• Follow up on questions, deadlines, incomplete work, and unresolved issues.

• Hold the technical team accountable for documentation, testing, and final results.

• Improve our website maintenance, monitoring, QA, and development processes.

• Escalate issues to the agency owner only when they require a major budget, client, or business decision.



Documentation

• Maintain accurate technical records for each website.

• Document hosting, DNS, domains, website platforms, themes, plugins, integrations, forms, analytics, custom code, and unusual configurations.

• Record troubleshooting steps and completed repairs.

• Create and improve technical standard operating procedures.

• Maintain QA and website audit checklists.

• Ensure another qualified tea
mber could understand and support each website using the available documentation.



Communication

• Provide clear and concise updates about problems, progress, risks, and completed work.

• Explain technical issues in language that nontechnical tea
mbers can understand.

• Ask thoughtful questions when a request or issue is unclear.

• Communicate proactively when a deadline, platform limitation, or technical risk may affect the outcome.

• Focus on resolving problems rather than assigning blame.



Skills and Experience

Strong experience in several of the following areas is preferred:

• Website operations or technical support

• Managing multiple client websites

• WordPress

• Shopify

• SilverStripe or other content management systems

• Website hosting and control panels

• Cloudflare

• Domain and DNS management

• SSL certificates

• Website backups and security

• Contact forms and SMTP

• Transactional
 delivery

• HTML and CSS

• PHP and basic JavaScript

• Website migrations

• Plugin, theme, and platform updates

• Google Analytics 4

• Google Tag Manager

• Google Search Console

• Website uptime and performance monitoring

• Mobile and cross-browser testing

• Third-party integrations and APIs

• ClickUp or similar project management systems



You are not expected to know everything. We care deeply about your ability to research, troubleshoot, learn, communicate, and take responsibility.



You May Be a Great Fit If You:

• Enjoy troubleshooting and solving technical puzzles.

• Are naturally thorough and organized.

• Notice details that other people miss.

• Are comfortable taking responsibility for an issue from beginning to end.

• Test the actual client-facing result before closing a task.

• Communicate clearly and consistently.

• Work well independently without constant reminders.

• Are willing to investigate unfamiliar platforms.

• Can prioritize several competing website issues.

• Know when to solve a problem yourself and when to involve a specialist.

• Focus on solutions instead of blame.

• Want a stable, long-term role with a supportive company.



This Position Is Probably Not a Good Fit If You:

• Only want to write code.

• Need every task broken into detailed step-by-step instructions.

• Prefer to work only on one website platform.

• Avoid investigating unfamiliar systems.

• Complete your assigned portion without checking the final outcome.

• Wait for someone else to follow up.

• Close tasks without testing the work.

• Point out who caused a problem without helping resolve it.

• Are primarily looking for several short-term freelance projects.



Schedule and Working Arrangement

• This is a fully remote position.

• The position will begin at approximately 15 hours per week.

• The first 90 days will be structured as a paid contractor trial period.

• In the United States, Colorado business hours are required.

• The weekly schedule and expected availability will be agreed upon before starting.

• During the first 30-day trial, you will begin with responsibility for a selected group of websites rather than our entire portfolio.



Opportunity After the 90-Day Trial

During the 90-day period, we will review:

• Technical ability

• Troubleshooting and problem-solving

• Reliability and responsiveness

• Quality assurance

• Communication

• Initiative

• Documentation

• Ability to manage issues through final resolution

• Fit with our team and company culture



For the right person, our intention is to:

• Increase the number of weekly hours

• Increase compensation based on performance and responsibility

• Transition the position from contractor status to a long-term employee role

• Expand ownership of website operations, monitoring, QA, technical workflow, and team coordination



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with our company, not simply complete a temporary project.



Paid Trial Project

Final candidates may be invited to complete a paid practical trial.

The trial may involve:

• Auditing several websites

• Testing forms and verifying
 delivery

• Investigating a reported technical issue

• Reviewing completed development work

• Prioritizing a list of website concerns

• Documenting findings and recommendations

• Explaining what you would fix directly and what requires a specialist

We will evaluate technical knowledge, but we will be equally focused on ownership, judgment, curiosity, communication, organization, and follow-through.



How to Apply

Begin your application with the words:

“I take ownership.”



Applications that do not include this phrase may not be reviewed.

Please answer the following questions:

1. Tell us briefly about yourself and your website operations or technical support experience.

2. Approximately how many websites have you managed or supported at the same time?

3. Which website platforms and technical systems do you know best?

4. Tell us about a difficult website problem you investigated and resolved.

5. Describe a time you discovered a technical issue before the client or customer reported it.

6. Tell us about a time you had to learn an unfamiliar platform, integration, or technical system.

7. How do you verify that a website contact form is working correctly?

8. How do you approach a task that has unclear or incomplete instructions?

9. What does “taking ownership” mean to you in a technical role?

10. What is your current availability?

11. What is your desired hourly rate for the initial 90-day contractor period?

12. Are you interested in transitioning into a longer-term employee role with increased hours after a successful trial?



Please also respond to the following scenario:

You discover that a contact form on a client’s website appears to submit successfully, but the client has not received any inquiries for several weeks. Walk us through exactly what you would do from the 
nt you discover the problem through final resolution, client communication, documentation, and future prevention.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Customer Service Representative & Dispatcher
description:

We're growing and need a sharp, reliable Customer Service Representative & Dispatcher to be the voice of our company and the engine of our daily schedule.

This is a hybrid CSR/Dispatcher position — you'll be the first point of contact for our customers AND the person making sure our technicians are routed efficiently throughout the day. You'll work directly out of Housecall Pro (our field service management platform) and Ply (our workflow/process tool), so comfort with software and the ability to learn new systems quickly is essential.



This is a long-term, full-time position for someone who wants to grow with a company — not a short-term gig.



What You'll Do



Customer Service:





Answer inbound calls, texts, and
s from customers professionally and warmly

Book new service calls, estimates, and installations into Housecall Pro

Follow up on quotes, missed calls, and outstanding customer questions

A background in both customer service AND logistics/dispatch (not just one or the other)

title: Real Estate Video Editor (Cinematic + Reels)
description:
TLC Property Lens is a real estate photography and videography company based in Austin, Texas, serving agents and short-term rental hosts across Austin and the Texas Hill Country. We shoot listing videos, cinematic walkthroughs, and social reels — and we're looking for a skilled video editor to help us turn raw footage into polished, high-end final products.

What You'll Be Editing

We offer a few different service tiers, so the work varies:



Basic/Essentials edits — clean, simple listing videos with music, text overlays, and smooth transitions

Cinematic walkthroughs — moodier, story-driven edits with color grading, sound design, and a slower, more immersive pace

Luxury property films — our top-tier product. These need to feel like a high-end real estate brand film: rich color grading, elegant pacing, premium music, refined typography



Every video — regardless of tier — needs to carry a luxury feel. Even our simpler edits should look polished and upscale, not generic or template-y.



What We're Looking For:

- Strong portfolio of real estate, luxury lifestyle, or brand film editing (please include links or samples)

- Skilled in color grading and pacing for a cinematic, high-end look

- Comfortable editing both short-form reels (Instagram/TikTok style) and longer cinematic walkthroughs

- Strong eye for music selection and sound design

- Proficient in any major editing software (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, etc.) — just let us know what you use

- Reliable communication, and able to agree on and hit a turnaround time per project

-- Bonus: experience with luxury real estate, hospitality, or brand content



How This Works

- Paid per video/project — rate depends on complexity (basic edit vs. cinematic vs. luxury tier)

- Ongoing, freelance/part-time work — expect roughly 5-15 videos a month, though it may vary

title: SHOPIFY Virtual Assistant
description:
We are currently on the lookout for a VA to take over the day-to-day operations of our online e-Commerce Shopify store based in New Zealand. The candidate will be required to work 8am-5pm New Zealand time (NZ is 4hrs ahead of the Philippines).



Important: Your two most important skills will be good working knowledge of Shopify (strong demonstrated user) and your English speaking ability (comfortable with taking customer phone calls).



We are looking for someone who is happy to work on an hourly rate - payments can be made weekly / monthly.



The VA will need to handle customer service (process orders in Shopify, take phone calls, e-mails and Live chat), upload new products to our website, with a little bit of social media management as well.



Our products are construction products like reinforcing steel, temporary fencing, plasterboard, etc. Soon we will also be branching into garden sheds, greenhouses, pergolas and other home / backyard products.



We have lots of draft e-mails saved that the VA will be able to use to respond to customer enquiries.



Here is an outline of the typical daily activities and the skills we are looking for:



- High level of written and spoken English. One of the first steps of the recruitment process will be recording a 1-2min voice message.

- Experience with using Shopify online e-Commerce platform (please do not apply if you don't have WORKING Shopify experience).

- Receive customer enquiries via phone calls, e-mail and online chat - ability to respond professionally and politely to customer enquiries.

- Get delivery quotes from our suppliers for these customer enquiries.

- Send quotes via e-mail to customers for pick-up and delivery orders.

- Coordinate with our suppliers to ensure products are delivered on time (if the order has a deadline), otherwise within 2-3 working days.

- Two weekly posts to our social media pages to advertise one of our products or share a customer review.

- Candidates who are familiar with Shopify e-Commerce platform will be highly preferred - daily tasks inside Shopify will include the following:

* Orders which are placed online and paid via credit card need to be processed (get quote from Supplier and pay supplier).

* For enquiries which are received via e-mail or the store's "Get a Quote" form - draft orders need to be generated manually inside Shopify.

* Send draft invoices to customers for these manual orders so they can make payment via internet banking (we have an app that generates the invoices).

* Upload new products to the store (including product descriptions and images - can be done via AI - training will be provided - it's pretty easy).

- Other tasks inside the business might include collecting customer reviews, maintaining a clean e-mail inbox (moving older e-mails inside folders), SEO, link-building, accounting/bookkeeping (training can be provided for the correct candidate).

- Working hours will be 8am to 5pm New Zealand time, Monday to Friday.



Feel free to get in touch if your experience and skills match our job description and let us know how soon you are able to start.

title: Senior Photoshop Product Retoucher (Commercial Products)
description:
Senior Adobe Photoshop Product Retoucher & Photo Editor



We’re looking for someone who genuinely loves Photoshop. If you enjoy taking an image from “good” to “indistinguishable from a professional commercial photograph,” you’ll fit right in.



We are a growing U.S. dairy company with multiple consumer brands seeking an exceptional Photoshop specialist for a long-term independent contractor relationship.



We care deeply about quality, realism, consistency, and attention to detail. Our goal is to create polished product imagery that looks as though it came directly from a professional commercial photo shoot.



This is an ongoing contractor opportunity with a consistent monthly workload. We are looking for someone interested in building a dependable, long-term working relationship—not completing occasional one-time projects.



What You’ll Do



You will transform raw product photography and existing creative assets into polished, production-ready imagery for digital and print marketing.



Projects may include:



High-end product photo retouching

Product cleanup and enhancement

Removing dust, scratches, glare, and imperfections

Label replacements

Packaging modifications

Creating new product or flavor variations

White-background e-commerce images

Product composites

Lifestyle composites

Background removal and replacement

Extending or rebuilding backgrounds

Color correction and precise color matching

Creating realistic shadows and reflections

Matching lighting, perspective, texture, and depth

Maintaining visual consistency across product lines

Preparing organized, layered Photoshop files

Advertising and marketing graphics

Print-ready assets

Preparing images for websites, Amazon, social media, retail advertising, and print



Most assignments will be completed in Adobe Photoshop.



What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who notices small details that other people miss.



You should enjoy perfecting an image and take pride in producing realistic, commercially polished work. You should be able to look at an edit critically and recognize when lighting, shadows, reflections, perspective, proportions, or color do not look natural.



You should also be comfortable:



Working independently

Managing your own workflow and schedule

Meeting agreed-upon deadlines

Communicating clearly and consistently

Receiving detailed creative feedback

Completing revisions accurately

Maintaining organized working files

Protecting confidential company materials



This opportunity is best suited to someone who values precision and realism. Candidates who prefer quick, basic edits over detailed commercial retouching are unlikely to be a good fit.



Required Skills

Expert-level Adobe Photoshop

Commercial product retouching

Advanced product compositing

Smart Objects

Layer Masks

Pen Tool and clipping paths

Advanced selections and masking

Camera Raw

Color correction and color matching

Perspective and distortion correction

Realistic shadow and reflection creation

Non-destructive editing

Organized, layered PSD file preparation

Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is highly valuable:



Food and beverage photography

Consumer packaged goods

Product packaging

Cosmetics or beauty products

E-commerce product imagery

Amazon listing images

Advertising-agency production

Adobe Lightroom

Adobe Illustrator

Adobe InDesign

AI-assisted Photoshop tools used with professional judgment

Portfolio Required



Please provide a portfolio containing examples of commercial photo editing, product retouching, or advanced Photoshop compositing.



We are especially interested in seeing:



Product before-and-after examples

Packaging or label replacements

Realistic product composites

White-background product images

Food, beverage, cosmetics, or consumer-product work

Examples involving difficult lighting, shadows, reflections, or color matching



Portfolios focused primarily on logos, branding, basic social media templates, UI/UX, or general graphic design are unlikely to be a strong fit.



Contractor Arrangement



This is a long-term independent contractor opportunity with consistent assignments and monthly compensation.



You will:



Work remotely using your own computer, software, and workspace

Control your own working process and daily schedule

Be responsible for meeting agreed-upon deadlines

Submit completed work and organized source files

Be responsible for your own taxes and local business obligations



Compensation will be established as a monthly contractor fee based on experience, portfolio quality, availability, and the agreed scope of services.



Expected monthly contractor rate: $1,000–$2,000 USD.



Application Instructions



To be considered, please include:



A link to your portfolio

The number of years you have used Adobe Photoshop professionally

Your experience with commercial product retouching

Your favorite Photoshop project and why

Your typical workflow for replacing a label on a curved product while preserving realistic highlights, texture, perspective, and reflections

Your computer specifications

Your internet speed

Your normal working availability and time zone

Your requested monthly contractor rate

The word BLUEBERRY somewhere in your application



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.



Paid Photoshop Test



Selected finalists will be invited to complete a paid Photoshop editing test using one of our actual product images.



Every candidate selected for the test will receive the same source materials and instructions so that submissions can be evaluated fairly. The test will assess:



Realism

Accuracy

Attention to detail

Color matching

Lighting and shadow consistency

File organization

Communication

Ability to follow directions



All finalists invited to complete the test will be compensated.



Why Work With Us?



Your work will directly influence how our consumer brands appear across retail stores, e-commerce platforms, websites, advertising campaigns, social media, and print materials.



You’ll receive a variety of challenging commercial Photoshop projects and have the opportunity to build a strong, ongoing relationship with a company that values exceptional creative work.



We’re looking for someone dependable, highly skilled, communicative, and genuinely passionate about producing outstanding product imagery.

title: Short-Form Video Editor for a Home Organizing Company (Long-Term, Not a Gig)
description:
Here's who you are. You watch home transformation videos on purpose. When a messy closet becomes a calm one, something in you exhales. You cut to music by instinct — your edits land on the beat without you thinking about it. You know when a video should move fast and when it should slow down and just let the 
nt breathe. You've probably re-edited someone else's viral video in your head because the pacing was almost right. You're TikTok-native — fluent in trending formats, sounds, and 
s, and you know a hard zoom or a fast cut is a tool, not a reflex.



Here's who we are. Taylored Spaces Design is a Los Angeles home organizing studio — but the organizing is only the visible part. What we actually do is remove mental load — we give people their homes back, and with them, their capacity. We believe mess is a systems problem, never a moral failing. We never shame a before. We don't do corporate gloss, template graphics, or salesy anything. Our afters look like our clients' real homes, elevated — never like a catalog. The feeling we're selling isn't "pretty." It's relief.



Here's the problem you'd solve. We have a library of hundreds of beautiful raw clips — dramatic transformations, team process, real client reveals — sitting unposted, because we haven't found an editor who gets the feeling. Not faster cuts or fancier transitions: the feeling.



Here's what you'll get from us. A written Edit Standard that tells you exactly what "good" means here — pacing, music, structure. No mind-reading required; we did that work already. A monthly brief telling you which videos to cut. Footage organized by project. Per-video pay ($25–40/video, 8–16 videos/month to start, growing with the account). Long-term — we want one person who becomes fluent in our style, not a rotation of freelancers.



The kind of human who thrives here: calm over chaos. Notices details nobody else sees. Gets real satisfaction from creating order out of mess. Takes ownership without being asked. Doesn't need constant praise — the work landing is the praise. Likes improving systems, not just following them (we're building AI-assisted workflows, and the person in this seat will help shape them, not just execute them).



This is probably not for you if: you need daily creative direction; you reach for the same transition, template, or trend no matter what the footage needs; you think a slow, held "after" shot is boring; or you'd treat this as filler between bigger clients.



Here's how it works. Shortlisted candidates get a paid test edit: $35 flat, ~2 hours of work, 48-hour window, identical footage for everyone. We hire from the test, not the resume.



To apply: (1) 3 links to short-form edits you made (any niche — home content is a plus); (2) one sentence about a home/interior creator whose editing you admire and why; (3) one line answering: what do you think we're actually selling? (Hint: it isn't organizing.) Applications missing any of the three won't be read — reading the brief is the first test.

title: Procurement Specialist (experience with US and Asian suppliers required)
description:
About Starbond

Starbond is a U.S.-based manufacturer and eCommerce company specializing in high-performance adhesives and industrial products. We serve customers through Amazon, Shopify, and B2B distribution channels across multiple global markets.



We are looking for a Procurement Specialist who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys building supplier relationships, negotiating favorable commercial terms, solving supply chain challenges, and continuously improving procurement operations. This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, proactive, highly organized, and comfortable working with suppliers across multiple countries and cultures.







Position Summary

The Procurement Specialist is responsible for sourcing and managing suppliers across the United States and Asia, negotiating pricing and commercial terms, evaluating supplier capabilities, and ensuring a reliable and cost-effective supply of materials.



This role plays a critical part in protecting supply continuity, reducing procurement costs, supporting contract manufacturing initiatives, and ensuring Starbond maintains a diversified supplier network that supports long-term business growth.



Key Responsibilities



Strategic Sourcing

Source, evaluate, and qualify suppliers across the United States and Asia.

Conduct supplier research, RFQs, quotation comparisons, and supplier evaluations.

Develop and maintain qualified primary and backup suppliers for critical materials.

Identify new sourcing opportunities that improve cost, quality, and supply continuity.

Support contract manufacturer and third-party logistics (3PL) sourcing initiatives.

Verify supplier capabilities, certifications, and compliance requirements.



Supplier Relationship Management

Build and maintain strong professional relationships with suppliers.

Monitor supplier responsiveness, lead times, pricing, and overall performance.

Conduct supplier performance reviews and maintain supplier scorecards.

Coordinate corrective actions when supplier performance issues arise.

Work closely with suppliers to resolve procurement challenges and minimize operational disruptions.



Cost Optimization

Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and commercial agreements.

Analyze supplier quotations and landed costs.

Benchmark supplier pricing and market conditions.

Identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality and supply reliability.

Recommend sourcing strategies that improve overall profitability.



Procurement Operations

Maintain accurate supplier records and procurement databases.

Support purchase order creation and supplier follow-ups.

Keep supplier pricing, lead times, MOQs, and procurement data up to date.

Organize procurement documentation and sourcing records.

Ensure procurement information is accurate, complete, and audit-ready.



Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Prepare procurement reports and sourcing updates.

Maintain procurement dashboards and tracking tools.

Identify opportunities to improve procurement processes and documentation.

Support continuous improvement initiatives across procurement and supply chain operations.

Proactively identify supply risks and recommend mitigation strategies.





Qualifications



Required

Minimum 3 years of experience in procurement, sourcing, purchasing, or supply chain.

Hands-on experience working with both U.S. and Asian suppliers (China, Taiwan, Vietnam, India, or other APAC countries).

Proven experience sourcing, qualifying, and negotiating with international suppliers.

Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.

Excellent analytical and cost analysis abilities.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.



Preferred

Experience working with contract manufacturers or OEM/ODM suppliers.

Experience supporting manufacturing, industrial products, chemicals, or eCommerce businesses.

Familiarity with ERP, MRP, or procurement management systems.

Experience analyzing supplier performance metrics and procurement KPIs.





What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who:

Takes ownership and follows through without constant supervision.

Builds strong supplier relationships while negotiating effectively.

Thinks strategically and solves problems proactively.

Communicates clearly and escalates risks early.

Makes data-driven decisions rather than assumptions.

Continuously looks for opportunities to improve procurement processes.

Is highly organized and detail-oriented.

Can comfortably work with suppliers across different countries, cultures, and time zones.

title: Ai UGC & Creative Rockstar
description:
We are a fast-moving performance marketing company focused on affiliate marketing, SaaS, and e-commerce. We use high-quality creative to test offers, capture attention, and drive measurable results across paid advertising channels.



We are looking for an AI UGC specialist who can create realistic, believable user-generated content that is virtually indistinguishable from footage created by a real person.



The Role



Your primary responsibility will be producing photorealistic AI-generated UGC videos for paid advertising.



We are not looking for generic AI videos, obvious avatars, or content that feels artificial. We want someone who understands how real creators speak, move, pause, react, hold products, frame their videos, and interact naturally with a camera.



The finished content should be convincing enough that the average consumer cannot tell it was generated using AI.



You will take scripts, hooks, offers, products, and rough marketing concepts and turn them into polished UGC-style ads that feel authentic, native to the platform, and commercially effective.



This is a hands-on production role for someone who actively experiments with new AI video, voice, lip-sync, avatar, and editing tools as they are released.



What You’ll Do

Create highly realistic AI-generated UGC videos for paid social campaigns

Produce AI creators and spokespersons who look, sound, move, and behave naturally

Turn scripts, hooks, testimonials, product demonstrations, and marketing angles into believable creator-led content

Match natural UGC characteristics such as handheld framing, realistic lighting, conversational delivery, pauses, facial expressions, gestures, and background environments

Generate consistent AI characters across multiple scenes, scripts, and creative variations

Create convincing product interactions, demonstrations, reactions, and lifestyle scenarios

Detect and correct common AI artifacts, including unnatural movement, lip-sync issues, distorted products, inconsistent hands, robotic delivery, and visual continuity errors

Edit short-form videos with strong cuts, captions, pacing, sound design, music, and platform-native formatting

Produce multiple variations of hooks, presenters, environments, scripts, and calls to action for creative testing

Create supporting AI images, graphics, landing-page visuals, and social content when required

Maintain visual and character consistency across campaigns

Organize, name, and file assets so the creative library remains easy to navigate

Turn around revisions quickly and incorporate feedback without unnecessary friction

What We’re Looking For

Demonstrated experience creating realistic AI UGC

A portfolio showing AI-generated people and videos that could reasonably be mistaken for authentic creator content

Strong command of AI video generation, character consistency, voice generation, lip-sync, image generation, and video editing

Hands-on experience with tools such as Higgsfield, Kling, Veo, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, CapCut, Midjourney, Flux, Google image models, or similar platforms

Strong prompting instincts and the ability to guide models toward specific performances, environments, camera movements, compositions, and visual styles

A sharp eye for identifying subtle details that make AI content feel fake

A strong understanding of real UGC conventions, including creator delivery, camera placement, lighting, body language, pacing, and authenticity

The ability to make polished content without making it feel overly produced

An understanding of direct-response marketing, including hooks, pain points, benefits, objections, social proof, and calls to action

The ability to work quickly, manage your own production queue, and deliver a high volume of usable creative

Strong written English and clear, reliable communication

The ability to receive direct feedback and make revisions quickly

What We Do Not Want

Generic talking-head avatars that immediately look AI-generated

Robotic voices, unnatural facial expressions, or poor lip-sync

Overly polished videos that do not feel like genuine UGC

Creatives with obvious visual artifacts or inconsistent characters

Someone who relies on a single tool and cannot troubleshoot weak outputs

Someone who produces visually impressive content without understanding advertising performance

Bonus Qualifications

Experience producing UGC ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or native advertising networks

Experience working with affiliate marketing, SaaS, or e-commerce offers

Experience creating testimonial, problem-solution, product demonstration, founder-style, and spokesperson ads

Familiarity with creative testing, conversion metrics, audience awareness levels, and direct-response copywriting

Experience creating AI characters that remain consistent across multiple campaigns

Experience producing content at scale across several brands or offers

Application Instructions



Begin your application with the word “lizard” to confirm that you have read the full job description.



Please include:



Examples of realistic AI UGC videos you personally created

A list of the AI tools you currently use

A brief explanation of your production process

Your typical turnaround time for a completed UGC video

A description of how you identify and fix content that looks obviously AI-generated



Applications without relevant AI UGC examples will not be considered.

title: Marketplace Multichannel specialist
description:
If you are unable to provide references from actual brands in the USA with whom we can speak to discuss your previous performance, please do not apply for this job. You will be wasting your time and it will also tell us you have not read the description.



Requirements:



This job is for Pacific Standard Time - 8 AM - 430 PM with some OT expected during peak times.

Time doctor use is mandatory.

Growth Mindset and leadership approach.



About the Role

We are looking for a multi-channel listing specialist who can build, launch, and optimize product listings across five very different marketplaces: Shopify, Walmart, Target, eBay, and Wayfair.

This is a listings-focused role. You will not be running ads or managing inventory sync — your job is to make sure every product we sell shows up clean, accurate, optimized, and conversion-ready on every channel where it lives.

You understand that each marketplace plays by its own rules. Shopify gives you total creative control. Walmart and Target demand strict content compliance and category-specific attribute precision. eBay rewards keyword density and item specifics. Wayfair is its own world of merchandising, dimensions, and class-level requirements. You know how to switch contexts and execute correctly on all five.

You are the person who asks every week:

• “Which listings are underperforming, and on which channel?”

• “Where are we missing keywords, attributes, or images?”

• “Which listings are flagged, suppressed, or non-compliant?”

• “Where is the biggest optimization opportunity this week?”

What You Will Own

Shopify

• Build product pages with SEO-optimized titles, descriptions, and meta data

• Manage collections, tags, and product organization

• Configure variants, options, and inventory display

• Optimize images, alt text, and structured data for search

• Coordinate with design team on PDP layout, badges, and on-page assets

Walmart Marketplace

• Create and maintain item setups via Item Spec or bulk upload

• Optimize titles, key features, descriptions, and rich media

• Ensure full attribute completeness (Walmart’s Listing Quality Score)

• Manage category-specific compliance and content scorecards

• Resolve content errors, item processing failures, and unpublished items

Target Plus

• Build item setup files following Target’s strict content guidelines

• Write titles and copy that match Target’s brand voice and guest tone

• Manage attribute completeness, images, and enhanced content

• Work within Target Plus Partners portal to maintain item status

• Coordinate item approval and resubmission workflows

eBay

• Build listings with optimized titles (80-character usage) and complete item specifics

• Write keyword-rich descriptions structured for eBay’s search algorithm

• Use eBay’s product catalog and category-specific required fields correctly

• Manage variation listings, store categories, and promotional content

• Monitor and improve listing quality, search visibility, and Best Match positioning

Wayfair

• Build product feeds with accurate class, dimensions, materials, and merchandising attributes

• Write Wayfair-style titles, marketing copy, and bullet features that convert in their PDP layout

• Manage image requirements, lifestyle imagery, and dimension diagrams

• Resolve content rejection issues and class-level data gaps

• Maintain product data quality scores within the Wayfair Partner Home dashboard

Cross-Channel Quality & Reporting

• Maintain a master content library so titles, copy, images, and attributes stay consistent across channels

• Adapt content to each channel’s rules — never copy-paste the same listing everywhere

• Audit existing listings on every channel for gaps, errors, and optimization opportunities

• Track listing health and content scorecards on every platform

• Build a weekly status report showing active, pending, suppressed, and flagged listings by channel

Who You Are

You are not a generalist VA. You are:

• A multi-channel listing operator who has worked in at least 3 of these 5 platforms hands-on

• Fluent in the language of product data: titles, attributes, item specifics, taxonomy, GTINs, variants

• Detail-obsessed — a missing attribute or wrong category is a personal offense

• A strong writer who can shift tone between Shopify, Target, eBay, and Wayfair without thinking about it

• Comfortable working inside multiple seller portals every day

• Calm under spreadsheet pressure — you can manage hundreds of SKUs without losing track

• Self-directed — you flag issues, propose fixes, and execute without hand-holding

Required Experience

• 3+ years building and optimizing product listings on marketplaces and Shopify

• Hands-on experience in at least 3 of the following: Shopify, Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus, eBay, Wayfair

• Working knowledge of marketplace content quality requirements and scorecards

• Strong copywriting skills for product titles, bullets, and descriptions

• Comfortable with bulk uploads, item setup templates, and feed files (CSV / Excel)

• Strong spreadsheet skills (formulas, lookups, pivots)

• Working knowledge of product taxonomy, GTINs, UPCs, and category attribute structures

• Experience coordinating with design teams on image requirements per channel

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Full content audit completed across all 5 channels

• Master content library built and maintained as source of truth

• Prioritized optimization backlog in motion, by channel

• Listing quality scores improved on Walmart, Target, and Wayfair

• Weekly multi-channel status report established with leadership

• Clear playbook documented for launching a new product across all 5 channels

Why This Role Matters

Every channel we sell on is a storefront, and every storefront is judged on its weakest listing. The right person in this seat protects our brand, lifts conversion across the board, and turns five marketplaces into five well-run businesses instead of five neglected ones.

Work Hours

Monday through Friday, Pacific Standard Time.

How to Apply

Send your resume and a short note that includes:

• Which of the 5 channels you have the most experience on, and how long

• A specific listing you built or optimized — what you changed, and the result

• The biggest difference, in your view, between writing a Shopify product page and a Walmart listing

title: Electrical Designer
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for someone who has been working as a Mechanical Designer and would like to take the next step in their career with Royal Engineering! 

What We Do

At Royal Engineering, we help turn ideas into reality. We have been serving Utah and surrounding states for over 30 years, offering a niche service to our clients that focuses on Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) Engineering design for commercial buildings. This includes designing HVAC, lighting, power, and plumbing systems. We work closely with architects to integrate our designs with the overall building designs.



We help bring life to buildings. Without our designs, buildings would be dark, uncomfortable, and without indoor plumbing. We work with architects and project owners to bring about their vision. Many times, that vision is a culmination of a lifetime of planning for the project owner.

We create our designs utilizing Revit and AutoCAD software, but our product is much more than virtual plans. Our purpose is taking those virtual plans to actualization for the enjoyment of thousands. 



If you are passionate about seeing your ideas (in conjunction with the rest of the team) evolve into finished projects that will be part of our communities for decades, keep reading. If you’re looking for just any job to pay the bills, don’t read any further. Honestly, it would save both of us our time.

Our Values

Professional Interactions

We are respectful and courteous. We are responsive in our communications. We build lasting relationships with co-workers and clients Collaborate, Coordinate, Communicate

We listen to others and involve all those affected when solving problems. We are helpful and elevate others so they can do their best work



Quality Solutions

We are organized and detailed in our work to produce accurate designs. We look at alternatives in order to provide the best solution for the client Do the Right Thing

We are honest and do the right thing even when it’s hard. We are accountable for our actions and seek to correct any missteps



Make it Happen

We look for ways things can be done, rather than making excuses. We also speak up regarding what limitations exist. We are flexible when plans need to change.   Drive

We are passionate and positive about our work.  We are self-motivated and don’t wait to be told what to do. We are eager to learn and are willing to try new things, even with failure as a possibility.  We don’t let our past failures determine our future potential

Why Join Our Team

• This is a space that offers a true sense of community where the well-being of our employees is a top priority 

• We recognize everyone has a life outside of work.  We are flexible with individuals regarding personal needs and schedules

• We care about your personal and professional goals and will support you in those pursuits

• Fellow team members are helpful and want you to succeed

• You’ll get to see the progress of your ideas becoming reality

• You’ll have a variety of assignments that keep work interesting

Who You Are

You are a details person! You are detail oriented and analytical. You are willing to do the work so that the project is on time and on budget. 



You are passionate about leading you and your team to demonstrate excellent engineering skill. You constantly look for ways to make things better. You are organized and are able to delegate effectively. You don’t feel the need to do everything yourself. You find fulfillment in watching others learn and grow and improve their own lives.



You take ownership of your role and make independent decisions. You look at alternatives to make sure the right options are being considered. You know when to stop analyzing and to move forward with a decision.



You are excited to be part of making the company successful by creating, implementing, and following budgets and timelines, submitting reviews, and performing site inspections.  



You are happy to help other teams be successful, without worrying about who gets the credit.  

So, What Will You Be Doing?

While there will be many different tasks you will work on, you will ultimately be responsible for three important results:

• Verifying and staying on budget.

• Having the utmost quality in the project. Taking pride in the work that is done. 

• Being on time. The project has strict deadlines we need to adhere to. 



Feel like this is a fit? Read on!















Things You’ve Done in the Past

• Experience in Revit and/or CAD. 

• Experience designing HVAC (including hydronics) and plumbing systems for schools, multi-family housing, office buildings, assisted living centers, warehouses, medical facilities, and other buildings





Why Should I be Interested?

• You’ll be part of a work that will be enjoyed by thousands.

• You’ll enjoy a strong culture of belonging.

• You’ll enjoy flexibility in personal and work life.

• You’ll have the freedom to streamline your area of work.

• You’ll be supported in your personal and professional development.

Are you the right person? 

If you’re excited about this opportunity, and feel like you have what it takes, we want to learn more about you!

If you are the right person, please send us your resume. Once we receive your information, we will reach out to you via
 or phone.

title: Local SEO Manager & Assistant
description:
About us

We're a local SEO agency that helps home-service and local businesses dominate their maps and local search results. We run a tight, systems-driven operation: clear SOPs, modern tools, and AI in the workflow. We're not looking for someone to reinvent the wheel — we're looking for a reliable right hand who can run our proven playbook across a portfolio of clients, keep every account moving forward, and flag problems before they become fires.

The role

This is a semi-autonomous account assistant role. You won't just execute one-off tasks — you'll own the day-to-day health of a set of local SEO client accounts. We'll train you on our systems and give you SOPs for everything. Once you're ramped, you'll run recurring work on your own, spot issues, and only pull us in when something needs a real decision. If you like ticking boxes, hitting deadlines, and seeing rankings climb because of work you kept on track, you'll do well here.

What you'll own

Google Business Profile & local listings



Optimizing GBP listings (categories, services, descriptions, photos, geo-tagged posts)

Building and cleaning up citations / NAP consistency across directories

Managing and responding to reviews inside GoHighLevel (using our approved response prompts/templates)

Content & on-page SEO



Managing our content assignment pipeline in our master content sheet (assignments, due dates, statuses, final URLs)

Coordinating page builds and publishing (service pages, service-area pages, blog posts)

On-page optimization: titles, meta, headers, internal linking, image alt text, schema basics

Assembling clean, on-brand client reports from our templates

Drafting client update
s and answering routine client questions professionally

Managing recurring task calendars so nothing slips

Light inbox / scheduling support

Keeping our tools and logins tidy and documented

A typical week

Monday you review every account and line up the week's tasks. Midweek you're publishing content, updating GBP listings, and responding to reviews. Toward month-end you're pulling rank data and building client reports. Throughout, you're checking the master sheet, updating statuses, and messaging us with a short daily or end-of-week summary of what got done and what needs a decision.

What we're looking for

Must have



1–3+ years of hands-on local SEO or SEO VA experience (agency experience a big plus)

Ability to interface with clients via text,
, or phone to coordinate onboarding, gather assets/logins/credentials, and keep them updated on progress as needed

Direct experience with Google Business Profile optimization and management

Solid written English; you can write a professional client
 and clean on-page content

Detail-obsessed and deadline-driven — you don't let things slip

Self-managing: you can take an SOP and run with it without hand-holding

Reliable high-speed internet, a capable computer, and a quiet place to work

Available during full US Pacific Time (PT) business hours — roughly 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific, Monday–Friday. This is a hard requirement; please only apply if you can reliably work these hours.

Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL)

Experience managing multiple client accounts at once

What we offer

Clear SOPs and real training — you'll never be guessing what "good" looks like

Modern, AI-assisted workflow

Room to grow into an account manager / strategist role as you prove yourself

Performance bonuses tied to client results and retention

title: Operations Manager for US Government Contracting Firm (Unanet + ADP)
description:
Full-time or Part-time| Permanent work from home | US Eastern hours  | IQ 124+ 



Viderity, Inc. is a US federal IT consulting firm based in Virginia. We provide technology and digital transformation services to US government agencies. We are a small team, and you will work directly with the CEO. We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager to own the administrative machinery that keeps a government contractor compliant, staffed, and paid.

This is a long-term position with real responsibility, not a task-based VA role. You will manage recurring processes independently, communicate directly with US-based employees and partner companies, and be trusted to make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Your Responsibilities



HR and Employee Support



—Manage the HR
 inbox and answer employee questions on benefits, leave, timekeeping, and company policy, escalating to the CEO only when needed

—Support benefits enrollment for new hires (health, dental, vision, 401(k)) and assist employees with processes like short-term disability claims

—Process onboarding and offboarding in ADP Workforce Now, including employment and benefits profiles and state payroll tax account registrations

—Coordinate recruiting: manage the recruiting mailbox, log resumes, schedule interviews, send written dispositions to candidates and partner firms, and track open positions to fill



Timekeeping and Invoicing



—Set up new employees in Unanet with correct project, task, and labor category charge codes, train them on time entry, and monitor their first timesheet cycles for errors

—Review timesheets every cycle and catch charge code or hours errors before they reach billing



Technical Recruiting Management



—Own the full recruiting cycle for open positions: intake of the requirement, posting, resume collection, screening coordination, interviews, disposition, and handoff to onboarding

—Maintain a recruiting tracker for every open requisition showing position, contract, labor category, candidates in process, current stage, and days open, and report status weekly

—Coordinate with our recruiting vendors and subcontractor partners: send them position requirements and job descriptions, log incoming resumes, and communicate selections and rejections in writing

—Schedule technical screens and interviews across US time zones and keep candidates warm with prompt, professional communication

—Pre-screen resumes against labor category requirements (education, years of experience, certifications, clearance eligibility) and flag gaps before they reach the technical reviewers

—Prepare selected candidate packages for client resume review and approval, and track approval status

—For mid-contract replacements, track remaining position hours so backfills are scoped correctly

—Watch for resume fraud signals (inconsistent dates, unverifiable employers, identity mismatches) and flag anything suspicious before a candidate advances



Compliance and Account Management



—Keep our state tax, payroll, insurance, benefits, and registration accounts current so renewals happen on time, no form goes unfiled, and no invoice goes unpaid

—Track required annual training completion and signed compliance forms for all staff, with audit-ready records



Contract Administration



—Document new contract awards and contract modifications in organized contract files with key dates and requirements

—Maintain personnel compliance trackers (background investigation status, badge status, expiration dates) for our staff and subcontractor staff

—Track subcontractor insurance certificates and required annual certifications, chase renewals before they lapse, and file signed responses



Social Media and Communications



—Prepare posts and post regularly to our LinkedIn and other company channels: contract announcements, certifications, and industry content

—Support press releases and company communications



Requirements



—Excellent written and spoken English. Most of this job is writing clear, professional
s to US employees, partner companies, and vendors. Your English must be indistinguishable from a US-based operations professional.

—Hands-on experience with Unanet is strongly preferred. Experience with another US government contractor timekeeping and billing system is acceptable.

—Hands-on experience with ADP (Workforce Now preferred), including onboarding, employee records, and payroll-adjacent tasks.

—Exceptional attention to detail. Errors in charge codes, filings, or certifications cost real money. You should be the kind of person who is bothered by a missed deadline.

—Ability to manage many small recurring workstreams independently without reminders.

—Discretion with confidential personnel, salary, and contract information.

—Available during US Eastern business hours (9pm to 5am Philippine time). This is firm; the role requires same-day responsiveness to US employees.

—Reliable high-speed internet, backup power and internet solution, and a quiet workspace.



Nice to Have



—Prior work for a US government contractor or consulting firm

—Familiarity with US payroll and state tax registrations, such as unemployment insurance

—Social media or communications experience



What We Offer



—Long-term, stable role with a company in business since 2008

—Direct access to the CEO and real ownership of your work



How to Apply

Send your resume and a short cover message. In the first line of your message, write the word CADENCE so we know you read the full post. Tell us specifically which timekeeping and payroll systems you have used and for how long. Applications without system-specific detail will not be considered.

title: 3D Sculptor / 3D Artist Wanted (Blender,ZBrush, Nomad, etc.) — $5/hr + $7 Per Model Bonus, Long-Term
description:
Hi, I'm Rick! I run a growing 3D printing product business in the US, and the modeling workload has outgrown what I can handle alone. I'm looking for a talented sculptor to become my go-to artist for the long haul. Test jobs start immediately.





The work: I use AI tools to generate rough 3D models that arrive 70 to 90% finished on average. Most jobs are polishing and fixing these to match reference images, some are sculpting from scratch, and some are more complex pieces. Think characters and creatures, animals, figurines, seasonal decor, props, and plenty that doesn't fit any category. Styles vary from project to project, so comfort working in different looks is important. Knowing 3D printing basics (overhangs, supports, thickness) is a plus, but not a requirement.



Each job comes with: the rough 3D model, reference images, and notes, plus its own due date. No guesswork, no vague briefs.



You deliver: the finished model as an STL plus your source file, correctly scaled and ready to print. Jobs include up to 2 revisions, though most will need zero, and revision time counts as paid hours like any other work. All delivered work belongs to my business and can't be shared, posted, or reused elsewhere.



Timelines: every job card shows its due date up front, most a day or two out, with bigger sculpts getting more time. Some jobs are time-sensitive and marked priority, and those need to come first. Since models arrive mostly finished, most jobs take 30 minutes to 2 hours of actual work, so due dates are easy to hit if you're working steadily. Ever need more time? Just tell me before the due date, early communication is always fine.



The pay, kept simple:

$5 for every hour you work, PLUS a $7 bonus every time you finish a model.



Finish a model in an hour and you made $12 that hour

Finish 10 models in a week and that's $70 in bonuses on top of all your hourly pay



The bonus pays when the model is approved, meaning it matches the reference. If something's off, that's what revisions are for, and the bonus still pays once it's fixed. The faster you work, the more you earn, with no ceiling. At normal speed that's $10 to $14/hr effective. Paid every Friday through EasyPay, no exceptions, no delays.



Volume is 10 to 15 models a week right now, roughly 10 to 20 hours of part-time work, and growing fast toward Q4. As we get in sync, I keep jobs queued up on your board so there's always a next model waiting, no dead time between tasks. If you can handle the workflow, the work keeps coming. My goal is one reliable artist I send everything to, and for the right person this grows from part-time into full-time work. Prove you can handle it and I won't need to hire anyone else.



Why people like working with me:



Full flexibility. Work whenever you want, day or night. I only care that jobs hit their due dates.



Zero micromanaging. No meetings, no calls, no check-ins. Do the work well and you'll barely hear fro
 except "approved" and payments.



Clear specs, every time. References and notes mean you always know what "done" looks like.



Reliable pay. Every Friday, on time, every time.



How we'll work together: jobs arrive on a simple Trello board. Quick "got it" when you pick one up, deliver the file to the card when done. Job questions happen on the card, general chat over 
. TimeProof runs for timekeeping only, so hours count themselves with no timesheets and no disputes.



What I'm looking for: strong organic sculpting (Blender, ZBrush, Nomad, or similar), clean print-ready meshes, comfortable across styles, good written English.



The hiring process: shortlisted applicants get two small paid test jobs ($5 each), real work and real pay, never free labor. Testing starts right away, and the best performer becomes my main artist.





To apply, answer all 4:

title: Design Manager
description:
Design Manager — Short-Term Rental Interior Design (Remote, Philippines) 

Company: Ishita Interiors 

Location: Remote — Philippines. US business-hours overlap required. 

Compensation: $800–$1,000/month USD, based on experience, plus performance bonus.

Reports to: Director of Operations (process) and Principal Designer (design)





About us 

Ishita Interiors is a US-based interior design firm that designs short-term rentals — the Airbnb and vacation properties guests remember and rebook. We run virtual design and full-service design for investors across the United States, with a remote design team across the Philippines and India. We are growing fast, and we build systems, not chaos. If you care about getting the details right, and you like leading people who care about the same thing, you will fit here. 



The role 

We are looking for a Design Manager who can run several design pods at once and hold every one of them to a high standard. You are not only a designer. You are the person who catches the mistake before it reaches the principal or the client, who develops lead designers into stronger ones, and who owns the quality of everything that leaves your team. This is a leadership seat for someone with real design depth and real management instinct. 



What you will own 

- Lead and manage multiple design pods (lead designers and their juniors) at the same time, across several live projects. 

- Own the quality gate. Every design passes through you before it reaches the principal designer or the client. Occupancy, space planning, finishes, specifications, dimensions, and brief alignment — you check them, and nothing incorrect gets past you. 

- Cascade project briefs to your teams clearly, confirm they land, and make sure the design matches the brief every time, including after revisions. 

- Hold your team accountable. Coach and develop your designers, give direct feedback, and enforce the standard when work slips.

- Keep projects on schedule and flag risks early, before they become client problems. Present or support client-facing design reviews when needed. 



Who you are 

- 5+ years of interior design experience, with a strong command of the fundamentals: space planning, occupancy and floor plans, FF&E, finishes and materials, fixtures, lighting, and reading product specifications closely. 

- Proven experience managing more than one designer or more than one team at once. You have led people, not only projects. 

- Obsessive about detail. You catch the wrong bed in the wrong room, the material spec nobody read, the dimension that does not fit. This is the single most important quality for this seat. 

- Clear, fluent English, written and spoken. Comfortable communicating with US leadership and clients. 

- Skilled in the tools: SketchUp, Canva, and Google Workspace, plus a project management tool (we use Motion and Airtable). - AutoCAD and 3D rendering are a plus. A disciplined remote worker with a reliable setup and hours that overlap US business time. 



Nice to have 

- Experience designing short-term rentals, hospitality, or vacation properties.

- Experience working with US-based clients or firms. 

- 3D rendering skill. 



What we offer 

$800–$1,000/month USD, set by experience, plus a performance bonus tied to your team's delivery and client satisfaction. 

A real leadership role with room to grow as the company scales. 

A remote team that runs on clear systems and standards, not guesswork. Direct work with US clients and a principal designer who sets a high bar. 





Our hiring process 

1. Application and a short set of screening questions. 

2. A brief Loom video introducing yourself and your experience. 

3. A DISC behavioral assessment — we hire for fit, not skill alone. 

4. A live interview with a real design-review exercise.

5. A short paid trial on live work. We hire people who prove it quickly.



===============================================================

HOW TO APPLY

Submit the following to be considered:



1. Your updated resume

2. A brief Loom video where you introduce yourself and answer the questions below



Video Questions:



- How many years have you worked in interior design, and in which segments — residential, hospitality, short-term rental, or commercial?

- Have you managed more than one designer or team simultaneously? Describe the structure — how many people, how many concurrent projects.

- Which tools do you use daily? (e.g. SketchUp, AutoCAD, Canva, rendering software, project management tools)

- Have you worked with US-based clients or firms? In what capacity?

- What are your working hours in US time, and what is your remote setup — internet speed, equipment, backup power or connection?





?? Please read before applying.

Applications missing a resume or video will be automatically rejected. Videos that do not answer the questions above will also be automatically rejected, regardless of experience. Only candidates who follow all instructions will be reviewed.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
We are seeking a highly organized and strategic Executive Assistant to support our CEO. This role goes beyond traditional administrative support, requiring a proactive partner who can anticipate needs, manage priorities, and help the CEO operate at maximum efficiency. The ideal candidate will be someone who thinks strategically, is highly detail-oriented, and possesses the foresight to manage time and resources effectively. This person will be a key confidante for the CEO, handling email, calendar management, coordination of personal and professional activities, and serving as a reliable buffer to create valuable time for the CEO.



Core Competencies:



-Strategic Thinking & Initiative: Ability to think several steps ahead and anticipate CEO needs.

-Dependability & Loyalty: Must be a highly reliable support, maintaining loyalty and discretion at all times.

-Organizational Excellence: Detail-oriented, organized, and consistent in managing priorities and information.

-Adaptability: Capable of adjusting to shifting priorities and complex scheduling needs.



Key Responsibilities:



-Email Management & Organization

Manage and streamline the CEO’s inbox for efficiency and accessibility.

Prioritize and highlight critical communications for the CEO’s attention.

Maintain a logical and intuitive email organization system without overcomplicating folders.

Filter, delegate, and respond to routine emails to optimize workflow.



-Calendar Management & Strategic Planning

Oversee the CEO’s schedule, proactively resolving conflicts and planning ahead.

Monitor the calendar 2–3 weeks in advance to ensure readiness for key meetings and deadlines.

Coordinate meetings and events with internal and external stakeholders, aligned with priorities.



-Operational & Personal Coordination

Assist with professional and personal tasks, including travel and appointments.

Serve as a bridge between the CEO and the leadership team, handling non-critical communications.

Protect the CEO’s time and confidentiality with discretion and reliability.



-Project Support & Follow-Through

Coordinate timelines, resources, and progress tracking for CEO-led initiatives.

Prepare reports, presentations, and other materials for meetings.

Proactively identify and address areas where additional support may be needed.



-Proactive Task & Resource Management

Anticipate the CEO’s needs and implement solutions to manage workload and resources.

Organize and maintain accessible documents and files.

Act as a contact point to streamline requests for information or resources.



Key Qualifications:



-Proven experience (5+ years) as an Executive Assistant to a CEO or senior executive.

-Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, or related field (or equivalent experience).

-Highly organized with strong attention to detail and commitment to consistency.

-Demonstrated ability to manage email and calendars with a proactive approach.

-Strong written and verbal communication skills.

-Discreet, trustworthy, and able to handle sensitive information with the highest confidentiality.

-Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and other productivity tools.
