Requirements:



This job is for Pacific Standard Time - 8 AM - 430 PM with some OT expected during peak times.  

Time doctor use is mandatory.

Growth Mindset and leadership approach.  









We are looking for a senior Amazon listing operator who knows how to launch, rank, and scale products on Amazon — not just write copy. You live inside DataDive, Helium 10, and Brand Analytics, and you can read a niche the way most people read a book.



You will own the full lifecycle of our Amazon listings: from keyword research and competitive analysis on day one, through launch, ranking, and ongoing optimization. You will be responsible for the data-driven decisions that move our products up the page.



You are the person who answers every week:

• “Which keywords are we winning, losing, or missing?”

• “Why did this listing drop in rank?”

• “What is the next listing we should optimize, and why?”

• “Where is the next growth opportunity in this category?”



What You Will Own

Keyword Research & Competitive Analysis

• Run deep keyword research in DataDive (Cerebro-style reverse ASIN, competitor gap analysis, keyword opportunity scoring)

• Build keyword master lists segmented by priority, search volume, relevance, and competition

• Identify untapped long-tail and high-intent keywords competitors are missing

• Analyze competitor listings, reviews, pricing, and ranking patterns

• Map the competitive landscape for every product line

New Listing Launch

• Build SEO-optimized titles, bullets, descriptions, and backend search terms

• Write A+ Content briefs and Brand Story modules

• Coordinate image and infographic briefs with the design team

• Develop launch strategy: pricing, coupons, vine, PPC seeding, and ranking plan

• Set up parent/child variations correctly the first time

• Track launch performance against ranking and revenue targets



Ongoing Listing Optimization

• Audit existing listings for keyword gaps, indexing issues, and conversion leaks

• Run structured A/B tests on titles, main images, and copy using Manage Your Experiments

• Monitor keyword rank movements and respond to ranking drops fast

• Refresh listings based on seasonality, trends, and new competitor moves

• Improve conversion rate, session-to-purchase ratio, and click-through rate



Brand Analytics & Seller Central Intelligence

• Pull and interpret Search Query Performance, Top Search Terms, and Market Basket reports

• Identify share-of-voice gaps vs. top competitors in each category

• Track conversion share, click share, and purchase share by keyword

• Use Seller Central data to validate or challenge DataDive findings

• Flag listing health issues: suppressions, Buy Box loss, policy warnings, stranded inventory



Reporting & Dashboards



You will build and maintain:

• Weekly keyword rank tracker (organic and sponsored)

• Listing health scorecard by ASIN

• Competitor watchlist with movement alerts

• Launch performance reports vs. plan

• Optimization backlog with projected impact and priority



Who You Are



You are not a generalist Amazon VA. You are:

• A senior Amazon operator who has launched and scaled real products — not just edited listings

• A true DataDive power user (this is non-negotiable)

• Deeply analytical — you make decisions from data, not from gut feel

• Obsessive about keyword indexing, ranking, and conversion

• Comfortable reading Search Query Performance reports and explaining what they mean

• Up to date on Amazon algorithm changes, policy updates, and category trends

• A strong written communicator who can brief designers, copywriters, and leadership clearly

• Self-directed — you bring opportunities to the table, you don’t wait to be told



Required Experience

• 5+ years managing Amazon listings at a senior or lead level

• Proven track record of launching products and ranking them on page 1 for competitive keywords

• Expert-level proficiency in DataDive (required — we will test this)

• Strong working knowledge of Helium 10 (Cerebro, Magnet, Frankenstein, Index Checker)

• Hands-on experience with Brand Analytics and Seller Central reporting

• Experience writing high-converting Amazon copy and A+ Content briefs

• Experience running Manage Your Experiments (A/B tests) on titles and images

• Strong spreadsheet skills (pivots, lookups, basic modeling)

• Familiarity with Amazon Ads / PPC concepts (you don’t need to run campaigns, but you need to understand them)



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Full keyword and competitor audit completed for every active ASIN

• Prioritized optimization backlog built and in motion

• At least one major listing relaunch with measurable rank and conversion lift

• Weekly reporting cadence established with leadership

• Clear launch playbook documented for future product releases



Why This Role Matters

Amazon is a zero-sum game. For every rank position we don’t own, a competitor does. The right person in this seat directly drives revenue — every keyword you win, every conversion point you add, and every launch you nail compounds over months and years.



How to Apply



Send your resume and a short note that includes:

• A specific example of a listing you launched or optimized, with the keyword(s) you targeted and the rank/revenue result

• How long you have used DataDive and what you use it for most

• One Amazon listing mistake you see most operators make — and how you avoid it

title: Sales & Event Operations
description:
About Optimal AI



Optimal AI is building the quality and judgment layer for AI generated code.



Optibot, our first multi-agent system, serves as thoughtful code review agents that flag issues line by line, and fix them. Optibot identifies security vulnerabilities, technical debt, and compliance risks with full codebase context, while cutting PR cycle times and improving engineering velocity. Paired with our Engineering Insights Platform, teams get real-time analytics on code quality and productivity across every repo.



We're trusted by engineering teams at Bear Robotics, LG, MongoDB, MPulse, Prometric, and more. Backed by Act One ventures and Chingona Ventures, with a team of serial exited entrepreneurs, YCombinator, McKinsey and Boeing alums.



The Role

We're building out our events and GTM engine and we need a sharp, creative operator to own it. You'll be responsible for making sure our events, engineering leader dinners, virtual shows, and community gatherings are consistently full, high-quality, and running like clockwork. You'll also support our outbound pipeline with lead research, copywriting, videos and campaign execution. You will be expected to work Pacific hours, synced with our San Francisco HQ.



This role sits at the intersection of events, sales ops, and video content. If you love building systems, writing copy that converts, and making things look great, this is your seat.



How we work

? High ownership, high output. Everyone on the team owns outcomes end-to-end. We work best with individuals who are precise, fast, and great at unblocking themselves.

? Critical feedback is a gift. We give feedback directly and receive it without ego. Don't take it personally. It's how we get better.

? Customer-obsessed. We make an effort to talk to all our customers and relentlessly provide value to each of them.



What You'll Do:



Events

- Collaborate on end-to-end logistics for our dinner series and virtual events like venue coordination, getting guest lists sorted, RSVPs, run of show, name tags, and day-of execution.

- Use Clay, Heyreach, Instantly, Luma and other lead generation tools to build targeted invite lists and fill rooms consistently.

Content & Design

Sales & Pipeline Support

What We're Looking For

title: Google Media Buyer
description:
NOTE: Please do not apply if you primarily have lead gen experience.



About Lucyd



Lucyd is a performance marketing and growth agency helping ambitious wellness brands scale through acquisition, retention, creative strategy, and conversion optimization.



We specialize in building scalable growth systems for brands operating in complex and highly regulated industries — including cannabis, hemp, telehealth (including GLP-1s and peptides), supplements, and functional wellness products.



We are more than a marketing agency executing individual services. We operate as integrated growth partners embedded in our clients’ businesses, helping them solve challenges across the entire customer journey—from customer acquisition and retention to creative, websites, and conversion optimization.



Our team moves quickly, communicates transparently, and operates with a high level of ownership and accountability. We care deeply about outcomes, strategic thinking, operational excellence, and long-term client partnerships.



---



Why This Role Exists



The Media Buyer, Paid Search is responsible for owning the strategy, execution, optimization, and performance of paid search campaigns across Google and Microsoft Advertising.



This role exists to help our clients scale profitably through search while navigating the unique challenges of operating in regulated and policy-constrained industries.



Success in this role requires a combination of strategic thinking, analytical rigor, technical platform expertise, and a relentless focus on performance. The strongest candidates will be comfortable operating in complex advertising environments where growth often depends on creativity, experimentation, and the ability to solve challenges without obvious solutions.



---



Working in Complex Advertising Environments



Lucyd specializes in helping brands grow in industries where advertising is rarely straightforward.



Many of our clients operate in highly regulated or policy-constrained categories, including hemp-derived cannabinoids, cannabis-adjacent products, telehealth services, GLP-1s, peptides, supplements, and functional wellness products.



Success in these industries requires more than platform expertise. It requires curiosity, adaptability, strategic thinking, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches while operating within evolving platform policies.



We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex advertising challenges and can consistently find innovative ways to help clients scale responsibly.



---



Key Responsibilities



Campaign Strategy & Performance



- Develop, launch, and manage paid search campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising.

- Own campaign performance across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, YouTube, and other applicable campaign types.

- Build account strategies aligned with client goals, profitability targets, and growth objectives.

- Monitor performance daily and proactively identify opportunities for optimization and scale.

- Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, and spend allocation to maximize efficiency and return.



Testing & Optimization



- Design and execute structured testing initiatives across:

    - Ad copy

    - Campaign structure

    - Landing pages

    - Audience targeting

    - Bidding strategies

    - Product feeds

- Analyze test results and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

- Continuously improve account performance through data-driven experimentation.



Analysis & Reporting



- Conduct keyword research, competitive analysis, and market research.

- Analyze campaign performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and risks.

- Prepare and present clear performance insights and recommendations.

- Maintain a strong understanding of attribution, conversion tracking, and measurement frameworks.

- Ensure reporting accuracy and data integrity across accounts.



Collaboration & Client Support



- Partner with Growth Strategists to develop integrated acquisition strategies.

- Collaborate with Creative, CRO, and Data teams to improve overall funnel performance.

- Participate in client-facing meetings when needed.

- Clearly communicate search-specific recommendations, performance updates, and strategic opportunities.



Operational Excellence



- Maintain clean account structures and campaign organization.

- Ensure campaigns are launched accurately and on schedule.

- Troubleshoot tracking issues, platform challenges, and performance anomalies.

- Stay informed on industry trends, platform updates, and emerging best practices.

- Stay informed on platform advertising policies and proactively adapt campaign strategies as guidelines evolve.



---



Required Qualifications



- 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns.

- Experience managing multiple accounts simultaneously in an agency or fast-paced environment.

- Deep expertise across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, and YouTube campaigns.

- Demonstrated ability to develop creative, data-driven solutions in complex or policy-constrained advertising environments.

- Google Ads Certification.

- Strong understanding of GA4, attribution, conversion tracking, and performance measurement.

- Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and performance experiments.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple projects simultaneously.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience advertising wellness, supplements, telemedicine, hemp, CBD, or other regulated industries.

- Experience managing Microsoft Advertising campaigns.

- Experience with feed management and Shopping optimization.

- Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO) principles.

title: Load Coordinator (Direct Experience Only)
description:
Company Overview

GH Logistics is a growing freight brokerage and asset-based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. Our strength comes from reliable carrier partnerships, disciplined execution, clean communication, and scalable capacity across the U.S. 



As our network continues to expand, we are looking for a Load Coordinator to help build strong, long term relationships with carriers while supporting clean and on time freight execution. This role is not just about covering loads. It is the grassroots entry point into how GH Logistics moves freight from the ground up.



Role Overview

This carrier facing role focuses on carrier development, load coverage, verification, rate awareness, and clean execution. You will work directly with carriers to understand lanes, support coverage, and build long-term relationships. Tea
mbers who perform consistently and meet expectations may grow into operations, account management, customer development, or strategy.



What You’ll Be Doing



Carrier Development | Network Growth

• Reach out to 20–50 carriers daily to introduce GH Logistics

• Verify carriers for insurance, authority, safety, and compliance

• Complete carrier onboarding and setup documentation

• Educate carriers on our lanes, freight opportunities, and communication expectations

• Position carriers for repeat and long term business, not one-time loads

• Create at least one group chat per onboarded carrier daily

• Send mass
s to carrier lists to support load coverage

• Maintain organized activity tracking and communication logs



Load Coverage & Execution

• Cover shipments using GH approved carriers

• Source capacity through calls, load boards, and existing contacts

• Book at least one load through approved carriers

• Secure at least one dedicated or repeat lane per week through carrier follow up

• Manage carrier communication through structured group chats

• Follow up with carriers to create recurring lane opportunities

• Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution

• Update tracking spreadsheets daily with accurate activity data



Carrier Verification & Fraud Prevention

• Confirm that carriers are properly verified before freight is assigned

• Review authority, insurance, safety, and compliance information

• Watch for red flags related to double brokering, fraud, or suspicious carrier details

• Follow GH approved verification steps before releasing loads

• Escalate questionable carriers before moving forward

• Document verification steps clearly and consistently



Rate & Market Awareness

• Understand basic lane pricing and market movement

• Review equipment type, urgency, truck availability, and lane history when supporting coverage

• Negotiate professionally while protecting service quality and margin

• Know when to continue negotiating and when to escalate for guidance

• Communicate rate concerns clearly to the team



What Success Looks Like

• Consistent 20–50 calls daily

• At least 5 quality carriers onboarded and activated regularly

• Carriers are fully verified, set up, connected, and positioned for repeat freight

• Loads are covered on time with clean communication

• Communication is centralized, documented, and reliable

• Carrier follow-up leads to repeat usage and dedicated lane opportunities

• Verification steps are followed before assigning freight

• Daily trackers and spreadsheets are accurate and updated



Who We’re Looking For

• Have experience in Carrier Sales, Dispatch, Freight Brokerage, or Trucking Operations

• Comfortable making 20 - 50 outbound calls per day

• Highly organized, tech savvy, and able to manage multiple spreadsheets and group chats

• Type at least 50 WPM

• Thrives in a fast paced and high urgency freight environment

• Communicate professionally via phone, chat, and

• Performance driven and KPI oriented

• Capable of leading structured carrier conversations and daily meetings

• Follows instructions consistently and executes with precision

• Team oriented, coachable, and open to feedback without ego



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full Time & Permanent Remote Worksetup

• Monday Friday 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST (San Antonio time)

• Must work US business hours

• Collaborative Zoom based work environment (with camera open)

• Time tracking software used for accountability and performance support



Compensation & Growth

• Additional commission structure tied to load booking and carrier sales performance

• Performance Incentives: Based on carrier onboarding, activation, and load execution

• Career Path: Load Coordinator to Senior Load Coordinator to Account Manager

• We promote based on performance, consistency, and execution



Commission may be earned through:

• Covering loads beyond weekly quota expectations

• Developing carrier relationships that generate consistent lane coverage

• Building partnerships with larger carriers that contribute long term capacity value

• Creating dedicated lane opportunities through repeat carrier usage and relationship management



Why Join GH Logistics?

• Structured systems and clear expectations

• Hands on leadership and direct feedback

• Defined KPIs and measurable growth

• Opportunity to grow within a scaling freight brokerage

• Performance based advancement



What You'll Get

• Consistent pay biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Stable & long-term position

• Professional growth path

• Direct access to U.S. executive leadership

• Real operations work



If you’re looking for a role where effort is recognized and growth is tied to output, we’d love to hear from you.



Apply Here: 



Note: After submission, our team will review your information and contact you if you meet the qualifications for the role. Candidates with direct experience will be prioritized.

title: End-to-End Supply Chain & Logistics Lead (Amazon FBA Private Label Brands)
description:
We run two complementary Amazon FBA brands: one in a premium giftable category with strong Christmas seasonality, one in sports & fitness. We are at ~200 SKUs today, with a clear roadmap to ~500. We sell across 
, 
, and 
, manufacture in China, and ship into FBA, AWD, and 3PLs across the US, UK, and Canada.



** THE ROLE **



This is a senior role. The CEO and Head of Operations are looking for a trusted operator to take ownership of the supply chain and logistics function, “end-to-end”, from initial forecasting -to- factory floor -to- FBA shelf. Someone we can hand the keys to and trust to drive it forward with little oversight.



You'll inherit a well-documented operation, with a structured onboarding: our current Supply Chain Manager will support your transition, transferring knowledge of both brands, our suppliers, and our systems so you can take the reins with confidence.



We also expect you to work AI-first. The best person for this role uses AI daily: to pressure-test forecasts, draft communications, build formulas, and automate the repetitive parts of logistics coordination. At the same time, you verify every output before it touches a decision. AI leverage is how one sharp operator runs what used to take a full department.



** WHAT YOU WILL OWN **



— Supply chain strategy and execution across both brands, “end-to-end”. Each runs its own forecasting methodology; you'll master both and standardize where it genuinely helps

— Demand forecasting and order planning for 200 SKUs (scaling to 500), built in Google Sheets with the backing of solid data flows

— China manufacturer relationships: production scheduling, inspections, quality, MOQ and pricing negotiation, alternate sourcing

— International freight and logistics coordination: coordinator of carrier selection, cost vs. transit time, customs compliance, freight forwarders, 3PLs

— FBA inventory health: 45 to 90 days cover, avoiding stockouts and overstock, inbound receiving discrepancies, reimbursements, cases with Amazon

— The small, critical details: barcodes, FNSKUs, shipment labeling, compliance documentation, tracking reconciliation. You are the last line of defense

— A performance dashboard you build and own: forecast accuracy, inventory turnover, lead time, on-time-in-full, stockout rate, shipping cost per unit, cash-flow planning

— Alignment with marketing and sales, so inventory matches promotional plans and seasonality. Flagged early, with numbers

— Task and process management in ClickUp: every shipment, order, supplier action, and follow-up lives in ClickUp so the whole team has visibility, and nothing falls through the cracks. You will be expected to maintain it rigorously, not treat it as optional

— Proactive communication: updates prior to asking, risks flagged early, follow-through without being chased



** WHAT OWNERSHIP MEANS HERE **



In supply chain management, small mistakes compound: one wrong barcode or missed reorder point can be costly. So we work to a clear standard. Sanity checking is built into how you operate: reconciling totals, second-passing formulas, and gut-checking outputs against reality before they drive a decision. Occasional errors are part of the job; what we can't carry is the same error recurring, going unnoticed, or going unexplained. When something does go wrong, you own it: what happened, why, the impact, and the fix that stops it repeating. Work like that, and you'll have our full backing when things go sideways.



** MUST HAVES: SKILLS & EXPERIENCE **



— 4+ years in supply chain, with 2+ years personally running an Amazon FBA supply chain “end-to-end” (Bachelor's in Supply Chain or related field is a plus)

— Proven experience managing 100+ SKUs; multi-brand portfolios a plus

— Deep international logistics knowledge: sea freight, customs, import/export compliance

— Strong Seller Central command: restock/capacity limits, IPI, shipment creation, FNSKU and barcode management, AWD vs. FBA

— Advanced Google Sheets/Excel. You build models, not just populate them (array formulas, pivot tables, QUERY, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, IMPORTRANGE). We will ask to see analyses you've built.

— Demonstrable AI fluency: real examples of AI saving you hours, and of catching it when it was wrong or hallucinating

— Experience with seasonal products and Christmas demand spikes

— Comfortable delegating and reviewing the work of others when needed

— Fluent English, written and verbal (Mandarin/Chinese a bonus for supplier communications in their native language)



** WORK SETUP **



Reliable electricity and 50+ Mbps internet, your own computer, and a quiet workspace. We run all tasks, processes, and reporting through ClickUp: it is our central hub for visibility across the team, and strong comfort with it is a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Working hours must overlap with China and UK hours (e.g., roughly 2pm to 10pm PH time, or a split shift like PHT 10am to 2pm & 6pm to 10pm). We're flexible on the shape, as long as the crossover is there.



** PERSONALITY WE'RE LOOKING FOR **



A logician's mind: structured, methodical, rigorous. Obsessively detail-oriented, so spotting an off barcode or an ambiguously worded supplier quote is your default mode, not an effort. The right fit is someone with real agency: you push for action, take ownership without waiting to be asked, and juggle parallel priorities without losing oversight of the details. An independent operator and self-starter who stays calm under pressure during peak-season spikes and shipping delays. Fully accountable. Always improving the system.



** NOT A FIT IF YOU **



— Need step-by-step instructions

— Are a generalist VA with peripheral supply chain exposure

— Have not personally managed an FBA supply chain “end-to-end”

— Find details tedious, or paste AI output without checking it

— Are juggling multiple other clients



** THE PACKAGE **



— Full-time, 40 hrs/week; bi-weekly salary (3rd and 18th of the month)

— $1,900 to $2,400/month base (PHP 120,000 to 150,000), equivalent to $11 to $14 per hour, depending on experience

— 13th-month pay, pro-rated each December

— Health reimbursement up to $50/month (HMO, PhilHealth, Maxicare, etc.)



** HOW TO APPLY **



Complete the application form below. It includes a few short questions and two brief video uploads (you can submit partially and return to finish later):



Apply via this link:

description:

Customers deserve better products, a stronger brand, and a world-class experience. We’re here to raise the bar.

You'll be part of a small team making key decisions, solving meaningful problems, and building the foundation of the business from pre-launch. The pace will be fast, the challenges real, and your impact impossible to miss. Every decision you make will help shape how this business grows. 



We're looking for builders. People who embrace uncertainty, move with urgency, take ownership, and are driven by the opportunity to create something exceptional. If you're excited by big challenges, meaningful responsibility, and the chance to help build a brand from the ground up, this could be a game-changing opportunity for you. 



The Role:



As our Founding Head of Ecommerce, you'll be responsible for defining how customers experience the website for our new Shopify brand, building the strategy, operating model, and roadmap that powers long-term digital growth. You'll be integral in establishing the vision for our ecommerce function, shaping the customer journey, identifying opportunities for commercial growth, and building the processes, governance, and technology needed to scale. From platform strategy and vendor partnerships to performance optimization and cross-functional alignment, you'll ensure site experience becomes one of the company's most important growth drivers. 



We're looking for someone who thrives in building from the ground up – someone equally comfortable thinking several years ahead while making smart, practical decisions that move the business forward today. As the ecommerce function grows, you'll play a key role in building and developing the team, fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement.



JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 



Shape the Website Strategy 

-Develop and manage the long-term ecommerce vision, strategy, and operating roadmap.  

-Establish governance, priorities, and success metrics that align ecommerce initiatives with broader business objectives.

-Identify opportunities to accelerate growth through customer experience improvements, technology, merchandising, and innovation.  

-Evaluate emerging trends, tools, and technologies that strengthen our digital capabilities and competitive advantage.  



Drive Commercial Performance 

-Own the overall performance of the website channel including revenue, conversion, average order value, customer retention, and profitability.  

-Continuously optimize the customer journey from acquisition through checkout and post-purchase.  

-Develop data-driven strategies that improve customer engagement and commercial outcomes.  

-Champion experimentation through A/B testing, personalization, and continuous optimization.  



Build the Ecommerce Function 

-Establish scalable ecommerce processes, governance, and best practices that support future growth.  

-Lead platform enhancements, technology initiatives, and website evolution.  

-Evaluate, negotiate, and manage relationships with external agencies, software vendors, and strategic partners.  

-Develop reporting frameworks and dashboards that provide actionable business insights.

title: GoHighLevel and Zapier Automation Expert
description:

ta Ads, Google Ads, website forms, social media, and other sources.

mber.

Prevent leads from entering the wrong workflow.

Connect Meta Lead Ads to GoHighLevel.

Test every Zap from beginning to end.

Tags and Custom Fields

Workflows and Automations

Fix duplicate text messages and
s.

Improve follow-up automations.

Test every workflow using test contacts.

Record Loom videos explaining major changes.

Create a simple written SOP for our virtual assistants.

Explain how leads enter the system.

Explain how leads are routed.

Explain how tags and custom fields are used.

Explain how opportunities move through the pipeline.

Explain how to identify failed Zaps or broken workflows.

Provide a final report showing what was reviewed, fixed, removed, created, and tested.

Required Experience

GoHighLevel

Zapier

Meta Lead Ads

Google Ads lead integrations

Pipelines and opportunity stages

Lead routing

Workflows and triggers

Tags and custom fields

Contact and opportunity management

Filters and paths

Webhooks

Duplicate prevention

Troubleshooting broken automations

Testing CRM systems from beginning to end



Do not apply if you only have basic GoHighLevel experience.



Do not apply if your experience is limited to importing contacts, sending broadcasts, or building very simple workflows.



We need someone who can inspect an existing system, identify the problems, explain the solution, complete the changes, and properly test their work.

Start your application with the word:



PIPELINE



Applications that do not begin with this word will not be reviewed.

Interview Process



Our virtual assistant will review applications and interview the strongest candidates.

Position Details

title: GA4 / Google Ads / Google Tag Manager Conversion Tracking Auditor
description:
We need a short technical audit of our Google Ads, GA4, and Google Tag Manager conversion tracking setup.



This is audit-only. We are not looking for PPC campaign management, ad strategy, or ongoing marketing services at this stage.



Our website setup includes:



WordPress / Elementor pages

Custom PHP price quote, sample request, and order forms

Google Ads

GA4

Google Tag Manager

Possible duplicate tracking from a prior GTM setup

Possible historical tracking pollution from a copied/stolen version of our site using our tag



We need to verify whether Google Ads conversion data is accurate before making PPC decisions.



Main task



Create a verified tracking map and fix list.



The tracking map should show:



Business event

URL/page where it happens

Current tag/event name

Tool used

Whether the event fires once or duplicates

Google Ads conversion action

Primary or secondary status

Recommended fix



Please audit and confirm:



Which GTM container is installed on the website.

Whether multiple GTM containers or duplicate scripts are installed.

Whether GA4 or Google Ads tags are installed both through GTM and directly on the site.

Whether any conversion events are firing twice.

Which Google Ads conversion actions are primary vs. secondary.

Whether Google Ads is optimizing for the correct conversion actions.

Whether weak actions, such as page views, clicks, or generic engagement events, are being counted as primary conversions.

Whether key business actions are tracked correctly, including:

Price quote submission

Sample request submission

Order form start

Order completed / payment completed

Phone call or contact action, if applicable

Whether non-approved domains are sending data into GA4, GTM, or Google Ads.

Whether conversion values are set correctly, if used.



Deliverable



Please provide a short written report with screenshots showing:



What is currently installed

What is duplicated, missing, broken, or unclear

Which events fire and where they fire

Whether each important event fires once or duplicates

Which Google Ads conversions should be primary

Which conversions should be secondary or removed from bidding

Immediate recommended fixes

Clear instructions for our developer if code/page changes are needed



Required experience



Google Tag Manager

GA4

Google Ads conversion tracking

Google Ads primary/secondary conversion actions

Tag Assistant / GTM Preview

GA4 DebugView

Duplicate tracking diagnosis

WordPress tracking

Custom form/order tracking



Important



Please do not restructure campaigns, change bidding, edit ads, or rebuild tracking unless separately approved.



This first project is only to answer one question:



Can we trust the Google Ads conversion data? If not, what exactly needs to be fixed?



This is a short audit project. Estimated time: 2–4 hours.



If the setup is more complex than expected, please identify that in the audit. Follow-up implementation can be quoted separately after the audit is complete.



To apply, please answer:



1. Have you audited duplicate GA4 / Google Ads / GTM conversion tracking before? Briefly describe one example.

2. What tools do you use to confirm whether an event fires once or multiple times?

3. Can you review both GTM-installed tags and hard-coded website tags?

title: Amazon PPC Manager
description:
Job Description:



Snugell is a fast-growing US private-label brand specializing in CPAP supplies and accessories, with a catalog of over 100 SKUs sold primarily through Amazon FBA. Advertising is central to our growth, and we are seeking an experienced PPC Manager to take ownership of day-to-day advertising operations.



The primary focus of this role is our Amazon US account — it is our largest marketplace by a wide margin and where the substantial majority of your time and attention will go. We also maintain a smaller advertising presence on Amazon Canada, Amazon UK, and Walmart Marketplace, which require lighter ongoing management and periodic optimization.



You will report to the Director of Operations. Our advertising operation is well-documented — established SOPs, standardized campaign structures, and automation rules are already in place. Your role is to execute these systems with precision, identify what the automation misses, and grow revenue while maintaining efficiency.



We are an AI-forward company. We use Claude Code and AI-assisted workflows throughout our advertising and reporting operations, and we expect this role to work the same way.



Responsibilities:



Own day-to-day management of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns across 100+ ASINs on Amazon US

Provide lighter-touch management of Amazon Canada, Amazon UK, and Walmart Connect (via Walmart Seller Center) — routine bid maintenance, budget oversight, and periodic optimization

Conduct weekly bid, budget, and placement optimizations in accordance with our SOPs

Perform keyword research and rank tracking using DataDive and Helium 10 to inform campaign targeting and listing keyword strategy

Perform ongoing search term harvesting and negative keyword management, maintaining and expanding our per-product-family negative keyword library

Launch campaigns for new products following our established naming conventions and campaign architecture (single-keyword campaigns, product targeting, and auto campaigns)

Monitor TACOS (our primary efficiency metric), ACOS, and organic rank movement, and act on divergences

Oversee and audit Scale Insights automation rules, escalating anomalies promptly

Leverage AI tools (Claude Code, Cowork, or comparable) to accelerate analysis, reporting, and campaign work

Deliver weekly performance reports to the Director of Operations covering what changed, why, and planned next actions

Monitor inventory levels and coordinate advertising adjustments to mitigate stockout risk

Qualifications:



Minimum 2 years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience managing accounts with $10,000+ in monthly ad spend

Deep understanding of ACOS versus TACOS, including the judgment to know when a high-ACOS campaign remains strategically valuable

Hands-on experience with DataDive for keyword research, ranking analysis, and listing optimization

Experience with Scale Insights, Sellerboard, or comparable tools; Helium 10 for keyword research

Proficiency with bulk files and the Amazon Ads console; exposure to the Amazon Ads API is a plus

Demonstrated experience working with AI tools — hands-on use of Claude Code, Cowork, ChatGPT, or similar for data analysis, reporting, or workflow automation. You should be comfortable writing effective prompts, validating AI output against source data, and integrating AI into your daily workflow rather than treating it as a novelty

Strong Excel/Google Sheets proficiency

Excellent written English — reporting must be clear, accurate, and decision-ready

Minimum 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time

Rigorous analytical habits: decisions are validated across multiple time windows, not based on a single 7-day view

Preferred Qualifications:



Experience with Walmart Connect and/or Amazon Canada and UK marketplaces

Experience in medical or health-adjacent product categories, with awareness of Amazon compliance requirements (no medical claims)

Experience using AI agents or the Amazon Ads API for campaign automation

title: Trading Chart Research & Sync Editor (Content VA) – Remote
description:
Hi — hope you’re doing well!

________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



This is a long-term collaborative opportunity for editors who value consistency, creativity, and growth alongside a dedicated team.

________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



We run a high-quality trading education channel and are looking for a resourceful, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant who can listen to a narrated voiceover, understand the trading concepts being explained, and find (or recreate) charts that perfectly match each segment.



This position blends chart literacy with creative problem-solving — you’ll often need to recognize what’s being discussed even when the term isn’t explicitly stated, and then source or recreate the right chart to visually communicate the concept to viewers.







________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Responsibilities

________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Listen closely to the provided clip and tell the story through accurate, well-timed chart visuals.



Understand the trading term, setup, or market condition being discussed.



Locate, screenshot, or recreate high-quality trading charts that match the narration.



Add relevant effects, transitions, and annotations using Camtasia to enhance storytelling and maintain viewer engagement.



Verify each chart shows the correct instrument, timeframe, and clarity.



Organize and deliver charts in sequence for the video editor to sync.







________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Requirements

________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Strong understanding of core trading concepts (support/resistance, indicators, market structure, patterns, liquidity grabs, etc.).



Ability to deduce and identify setups even when implied in narration.



Hands-on experience with Trading View or similar charting platforms.



Resourceful and precise — able to find the best visual representation, not just the easiest one.



Exceptional attention to detail, timing, and visual storytelling.





________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Platform Requirement

________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Camtasia is required for the entire project.



You will be provided with all effects, transitions, and other tools needed to complete the work through our Camtasia Library package.



All work must be created, edited, and exported through Camtasia, ensuring all effects, transitions, and assets are properly embedded in the Camtasia Library Package (.libzip) format.



You may use the free version — a paid license is not required.



Ensure your system can run Camtasia smoothly and handle exporting without lag or crashes.





________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Training & Brand Style

________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Full training provided on our chart color codes, formatting, and visual standards.



Access to visual templates to ensure consistency across all videos.



The goal: maintain a clean, professional, and uniform chart style that aligns with our brand identity.







________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Nice to Have

________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Previous experience in trading or finance-related content creation.



Familiarity with educational or YouTube-based video production workflows.







________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Workload & Pay

________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



1 video per month (8–12 minutes each)



(Includes a 1-minute clip workflow to maintain consistency and quality across projects.)



Pay Range: $80 – $165+ per video



Based on:



- Skill level



- Creativity



- Accuracy



- Execution quality



- Turnaround time



- Effort level



The link below showcases the work produced by editors on the team. All of the edits are strong, but each one reflects a different level of dedication, detail, and overall quality — and that’s exactly why we use an incentive-based system.



The harder you work, and the more accurately and creatively you execute the story using chart visuals and our effects library, the more you earn.







________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Flexible schedule — because we view editors as partners, you’re trusted to manage your own time, work efficiently, and find the pace that suits you best while still delivering within a reasonable timeframe.



________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



How to Apply

________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Include the word “MACD” at the top of your application to confirm you’ve read this description.

In your message, please share:



Your experience with trading and charting platforms.



Any examples or samples of your past trading visuals or chart work.



If you have any questions at all , don’t hesitate to ask — we value clear communication and collaboration.



Thank you for your time.

title: Jr. Financial Analyst (Audit Cost, Margin & Profitability Analysis)
description:
Role Summary



The Jr. Financial Analyst is responsible for supporting financial decision-making through accurate cost modeling, margin analysis, and financial reporting. This role owns SKU-level cost and contribution margin models, supports pricing and promotional analysis, and provides visibility into inventory, cash flow, and operational performance.



The Financial Analyst partners closely with Supply Chain, Operations, Sales, and Finance to ensure financial models and reports are accurate, timely, and aligned across the organization.



Key Responsibilities



MAIN FOCUS (80%)



Audit Cost, Margin & Profitability Analysis



Own and maintain SKU-level cost models including materials, labor, packaging, freight, and overhead

Update cost assumptions when supplier, freight, labor, or production changes occur

Maintain contribution margin analysis by SKU and sales channel

Analyze margin impact of supplier changes, freight fluctuations, and production updates

Prepare pricing and margin impact analyses for promotions, discounts, and pricing changes

Identify and flag unusual cost or margin variances and summarize key drivers

NICE TO HAVE (20%)



Financial Reporting & Variance Analysis



Maintain monthly P&L and margin reports using standardized templates

Perform actual vs. budget/forecast and actual vs. prior month variance analyses

Identify financial trends and provide clear explanations of key drivers

Maintain standardized Excel dashboards, pivot tables, and financial models

Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and proper version control across reports

Cash Flow, Inventory & Working Capital Support



Maintain weekly cash flow forecast inputs and cash balance trackers

Track inventory value and inventory turns using predefined formulas

Model cash impact of inventory purchases, production timing, and supplier payment terms

Maintain B2B accounts receivable aging reports to support cash visibility

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Data Management



Partner with Supply Chain to collect and validate cost inputs

Partner with Operations on labor rates, overhead, and production assumptions

Collect sales volume and channel inputs from Sales

Ensure alignment and consistency across Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, and Sales models

Qualifications



Required



Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field

2–4 years of experience in financial analysis, cost accounting, or operational finance

Strong proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, lookups, structured models)

Experience working with cost models, margin analysis, or inventory data

Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple data inputs

Preferred



Experience in manufacturing, e-commerce, or supply chain–driven businesses

Exposure to inventory accounting, landed cost modeling, or contribution margin analysis

Experience supporting pricing or promotional analysis

Familiarity with ERP or accounting systems

We operate a portfolio of 12+ local home service brands across the U.S., plus a retail medical supply business with two physical locations and a national mail-in channel. Every brand generates leads, calls, jobs, orders, and money every day. Your job is to see all of it.

This is the nervous system of the operation. We are scaling, and scale without turbulence only happens when every moving piece is tracked, every handoff is clean, and every number is current. You build and maintain the complete, always-current picture of everything that needs to be done and everything that has been done — across every brand.



You will:





Own end-to-end tracking: lead source ? call ? booked job ? completed work ? money collected, for every brand

Build and maintain conversion tracking and attribution — GTM, GA4, and call tracking — so no lead is a mystery

Build and maintain the numbers dashboard — one live view of leads, jobs, revenue, and costs across every brand

Run operational logistics: order flows, processing pipelines, and handoffs between tea
mbers, so nothing sits and nothing gets lost

Maintain the planning system: daily, weekly, and monthly goals, the build backlog, and weekly review reports

Build and manage follow-up sequences — every lead gets worked automatically until it closes or dies, no inquiry goes cold

Write and maintain SOPs — every recurring process gets documented so anyone on the team can run it

Produce weekly analytics: cost per lead per brand, close rates, revenue, and profitability

Flag turbulence early — when a number moves the wrong way, you catch it before the owner does





Requirements





Strong spreadsheet skills — formulas, pivot tables, and clean data structure are second nature

Detail-obsessed — you notice when one number out of a hundred is off, and it bothers you until you know why

Systems thinker — you turn a pile of moving parts into a documented, repeatable process

Highly organized with a logistics mindset — files, trackers, and pipelines stay named, current, and findable

Planning and productivity are your nature — you run your own day like a system: prioritized, scheduled, and finished

A clear communicator — written and verbal; your updates, reports, and handoffs need no follow-up question

Grasps marketing technicalities — or picks them up fast: how websites, landing pages, ad campaigns, and tracking fit together. You don't run the ads, but you have to understand the machine you're measuring.

Self-directed — you fill your own downtime with high-value work without being told





Tools You'll Work In





ClickUp — expert level required. Tasks, projects, and operational pipelines run through here.

Airtable — expert level required. The planning hub: goals, build backlog, and weekly reviews live here.

Claude (Anthropic's AI) — required. You work alongside AI daily — analysis, SOP drafting, report building, and problem-solving. You know how to get real output from it, not just ask it questions.

Google Analytics 4 + Google Tag Manager — conversion tracking and attribution across all brand sites. Know it or learn it fast.

Google Sheets — analysis, reconciliation, and reporting

 — the automations that move our data. You understand what runs, monitor it, and flag failures.

Looker Studio dashboard building

QuickBooks or bookkeeping exposure

Experience in home services, lead generation, or multi-location retail

Your resume

title: Short-Form TikTok Editor (Spark Creator)
description:
SALARY: PHP 90,000–120,000/month (~$1,600–$2,100 USD) — with performance bonuses and raises as you prove out.



Hours: Full-time, structured daily schedule







Read this part first - 



Most editing jobs on here are churn-and-burn: vague briefs, no system, a client who disappears, and you're treated as disposable. This is the opposite. I'm building a small, elite team around a paid TikTok ad operation that's already working. I run on documented systems, clear SOPs, and clean structure. I pay top-of-market because I'm hiring one person for this seat and I want the best editor sitting in it, long-term.



If you're genuinely elite at native, organic-style TikTok editing — the kind that looks like a real person filmed it, not a brand ad — and you want a stable seat where there's a real path to grow with the company: keep reading.









The mission -



We produce high-volume, native-style TikTok content we call Sparks — short videos engineered to stop the scroll and pull a real reaction in the first second. Not corporate. Not YouTube-style. Not polished brand ads. Raw, fast, native-to-the-FYP content that looks organic and converts.



You'll work from briefs, hooks, references, and a documented Spark SOP. You're not inventing 50 videos from scratch — you're running a proven creative system at speed: core builds, hook swaps, variations, recuts. The system is mapped. Your job is to execute it at elite quality and volume, every single day, and to make each Spark feel native and alive.







What you'll do -



• Produce 30–50 Sparks/day off our documented system — core builds plus rapid variations (new hooks, new openers, recuts)



• Nail a specific native-FYP style from our reference library — casual, organic, scroll-stopping



• Work fluently with slideshows, text-on-screen, native captions, trending audio, and quick-cut footage



• Follow our naming, formatting, and delivery system precisely (clean operators win here)



• Hit daily output targets without the quality ever dropping



• Take feedback fast, iterate faster, and bring your own instincts for what makes a video hit







Who I'm looking for (non-negotiable) -



• Proven native-style short-form work — TikTok / Reels / Shorts in the casual, organic look (not brand promos). Your portfolio is the proof.



• Genuine speed with quality — you can produce volume without it ever looking mass-produced



• CapCut fluency (Premiere a plus) — fast, clean, precise



• Deep feel for TikTok pacing: 1-second hooks, fast cuts, native text styling, trend awareness



• Reliable daily availability and sharp, consistent communication



• Stable internet + a machine that handles daily video work without choking







What makes you stand out -



• Experience editing for paid ads / performance marketing, not just organic creators



• A real instinct for why a video stops the scroll vs. gets skipped



• Fluency in US-audience TikTok trends, humor, and rhythm







Why this seat is worth it -



• Top-of-market pay (?90k–?120k), with bonuses tied to winning Sparks and raises as you prove out. 



• Stability — this is a long-term core seat, not a one-off gig. I want you here for years. 



• Real systems — documented SOPs, clean briefs, reference libraries. You'll never be guessing.



• Growth path — as trust builds, this seat can grow into a lead creative role as the team expands



• Respect — your work is the engine of the business, and you'll be treated that way







How to apply (follow exactly — anything that skips a step is deleted) -



This is a competitive seat. I read every application that follows the steps, and I ignore every one that doesn't. 







Do all four:



• Put the word SCROLL at the very top of your application, so I know you read this in full.



• Send 3 examples of native-style TikTok / Reels / Shorts videos you personally edited. They must be the casual, organic-looking style — not corporate or brand promos. Make sure the links actually work.



• In 2–3 sentences, answer: What makes a TikTok hook stop someone from scrolling in the first 1 second?



• In one line, tell me the single best Spark/video you ever edited and why it worked (numbers if you have them — views, retention, conversions).







Strong applicants who show real native work and a sharp answer to #3 move to a paid test edit (a real Spark from a real brief). Nail the test and you're in.



I'm hiring one person for this. Make me certain it's you.

title: Automations & Client Delivery Assistant
description:
About Smart Ops Club

We help plumbing and HVAC business owners stop bleeding profit and start running real companies — not glorified job sites held together by duct tape and vibes. Our Replace YOU™ Operating System takes owners from Stability to Ownership to Scale, and we back it with real numbers, not hype.

We're direct. We're fast. We don't do fluff. If that sounds like your kind of place, keep reading.





The Role

We're hiring an Operations & Delivery Assistant to take the day-to-day off our founder's plate so she can spend her time where it actually matters: coaching clients and building the business. This is not a "wear 47 hats and hope for the best" role — it's a focused mix of admin support, systems/automation work, and helping run our client delivery platform.

You don't need to be an expert in every tool we use. You need to be sharp, allergic to dropped balls, and comfortable learning how a system works well enough to keep it running without hand-holding.





What You'll Own:



Founder time leverage (day one priorities)

- Calendar management

- Daily agenda prep + call read-aheads

- Task scheduling and follow-through

- SOP creation and upkeep for DMs and appointment-setting



Client delivery support (Skool + Airtable)

- Edit and upload recorded course modules to Skool

- Set up and maintain the private community space and tiered access

- Build and organize the document/resource library

- Maintain the Airtable client-journey tracker: milestones, cohort week, call-readiness flags, “ready to pitch Scale” flags

- Manage the milestone self-report form clients use to update their own progress



Revenue protection (fast, high dollar-per-hour work)

- Run the follow-up system for stalled/cold leads

- Track and improve sales call show rates



Systems & automation backbone

- Organize and maintain GoHighLevel — lead/sales pipeline and marketing funnel automations

- Support the GHL ? Airtable ? Skool handoff so client data flows cleanly between systems

- Build and maintain automations: onboarding sequences, weekly client
s, weekly tracking/reporting, testimonial requests, referral prompts, Q&A calendar reminders

- Build and maintain lead magnet funnel infrastructure in GoHighLevel (our marketing team writes the copy that goes into it)

- Build and maintain Airtable automations for marketing/content tracking, alongside the client-journey tracker





Tools You'll Use

GoHighLevel — leads, sales pipeline, appointment booking, and marketing funnel automations

Skool — course delivery, client community, tiered program access

Airtable — the single source of truth for where every client is in their journey

Google Workspace — calendar, docs, day-to-day coordination

You don't need to walk in an expert in all four. See below.





What We're Actually Screening For

**Ranked by how much it matters — read this before you apply:



1. Systems and process thinking. Can you hold a multi-step client journey in your head without dropping a step? This is the thing we can't train. Everything else, we can.



2. Database/spreadsheet logic. If you've used Airtable, great. If you haven't but you're the person who builds the color-coded tracker nobody asked for, that counts just as much.



3. Written communication. You'll write client-facing messages, SOPs, and internal notes that need to sound clear and human — not like a corporate template.



4. CRM or funnel tool experience (GHL, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, similar). Helpful, but the fastest thing to train on this list.



5. Course platform / online community experience (Skool or similar). Nice to have, easy to pick up.



6. Reliability on admin basics — calendar, scheduling, inbox triage. Table stakes. We're checking that you'll actually do it, not that you're impressive at it.





You're a Strong Fit If You

Notice when something's about to fall through the cracks — and catch it before it does

Actually enjoy building/organizing systems (not just tolerating them)

Write clearly and don't need heavy editing

Ask good questions instead of guessing and hoping

Can take a documented process and run it without needing it re-explained every time

Are comfortable with a founder who moves fast and expects the same





Not a Fit If

You need heavy oversight to stay on track

Ambiguity makes you freeze instead of ask

You're looking for a role that's 90% content creation or client-facing coaching — this is an ops seat, not a marketing or delivery-coaching seat
